jobs.title: Financial Crime Compliance Officer in the Area of CDB Compliance 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
At Julius Baer, we celebrate and value the individual qualities you bring, enabling you to be impactful, to be entrepreneurial, to be empowered, and to create value beyond wealth. Let’s shape the future of wealth management together.

Serves as a trusted advisor and subject matter expert on the Swiss banks' code of conduct with regard to the exercised of due diligence (CDB 20).

YOUR CHALLENGE

• Act as Competence Center for all CDB related matters within the bank, i.e. ensures the correct identification of clients/partners and the establishment of beneficial ownership according to the stipulations of CDB 20 spanning the entire client lifecycle from onboarding and to ongoing management

• Support Private Banking Front Management and Relationship Managers (RMs) of the Bank in all CDB matters during the entire client lifecycle. Coordinate and cooperate with other units of the Bank: Client Documentation Services, Business Risk Management, Compliance Units and Legal

• Independently review unusual transactions, analyse their economic background and assess if they are in line with the client’s declaration of beneficial ownership and KYC (Know Your Customer) profile. Undertake additional clarifications if deemed required

• Escalate issues identified along the review process, while initiating and monitoring mitigation measures to reduce the bank’s risk exposure

• Implement Compliance policies in connection with the identification of clients and the establishment of the beneficial ownership according to CDB 20

• Provide training and training materials in connection with CDB topics

• Recommend, develop, and implement solutions to support continuous improvement of our processes, procedures, and services

YOUR PROFILE

• Graduate degree in law / business economics or completed bank apprenticeship with corresponding further education (e.g. postgraduate studies in Compliance Management or equivalent)

• Multiyear experience in banking and Compliance in particular

• Good knowledge of CDB matters

• Capability to define problems, collect data, establish facts and draw valid conclusions: ability to interpret an extensive variety of data and deal with complex situations

• Ability to cope with tight deadlines, deliver independently under time pressure and communicate challenging decisions

• Skilled in resolving highly complex issues, with strong analytical skills, decision-making and prioritizations abilities

• Strong communication skills, ability to build and maintain sound relationship with stakeholders

• Good knowledge of MS Office and IT-flair of banking applications

• Fluent in English (written and spoken) and German (minimum B2 level); additional languages are an asset

We are looking forward to receiving your full job application through our online application tool. Further interesting job opportunities can be found on our Career site.
Is this not quite what you are looking for? Set up a job alert by creating a candidate account here.

jobs.description:
At Julius Baer, we celebrate and value the individual qualities you bring, enabling you to be impactful, to be entrepreneurial, to be empowered, and to create value beyond wealth. Let’s shape the future of wealth management together.

We are seeking a Zurich-based Market Abuse Monitoring Specialist for our Financial & Capital Markets Compliance team. The successful candidate will support our insider monitoring and trade surveillance globally.

YOUR CHALLENGE

• Serve as a trusted market abuse monitoring expert within a Business-Aligned Compliance function, responsible for alert assessments, reporting and escalation of potential breaches globally

YOUR PROFILE

• Professional experience in within a banking environment is considered an advantage

• Strong analytical abilities, sound judgment, proactive and self-driven, and a deep sense of ownership and accountability

• Strong communication skills in German and English

jobs.title: Compliance Officer – Private Banking Compliance 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
At Julius Baer, we celebrate and value the individual qualities you bring, enabling you to be impactful, to be entrepreneurial, to be empowered, and to create value beyond wealth. Let’s shape the future of wealth management together.

The Compliance Officer will perform high-risk client on-boarding reviews, including detailed assessments of Know Your Customer (KYC) and Financial Crime risks. They will also support relationship managers and management in implementing, advising, and supervising Compliance matters, conduct AML investigations, and review local policies and procedures when required. Additionally, they will collaborate with key stakeholders, instill a Compliance culture in employees, and support Compliance projects and audits.

YOUR CHALLENGE

• Performing high-risk client on-boarding reviews, including detailed assessments of Know Your Customer (KYC) and Financial Crime risks

• Supporting relationship managers and management in implementing, advising, and supervising Compliance matters

• Conducting Anti-Money Laundering (AML) investigations when necessary

• Reviewing local policies and procedures when required

• Identifying and investigating serious cases of non-compliance

• Collaborating with key stakeholders within and outside Compliance

• Instilling a Compliance culture in employees to mitigate legal, regulatory, sanctions, and reputational risks

• Supporting Compliance projects and following up on internal and regulatory audits

• Providing training and training materials on Compliance and AML topics

YOUR PROFILE

• Bachelor's degree (preferably in law, economics, business administration, or a banking-related subject)

• At least 3-5 years of experience in client onboarding, audit, or Compliance functions

• Knowledge of the Swiss regulatory environment, particularly AML regulations, and client documentation standards

• Sound knowledge of Emerging Markets (Middle East, Africa, NRI) and/or Asia

• Good knowledge of MS Office and a flair for IT

• Strong personality with good organizational, operational, and communication skills

• Ability to work under pressure, with excellent analytical, teamwork, and problem-solving skills

• Proficient in writing concise assessments, with a strong sense of integrity and discretion

• Independent, efficient, and meticulous work method, with solution-oriented thinking

• Fluency in English is essential. Proficiency in other languages is highly desirable

jobs.title: Senior Specialist - Employee related Conflicts 80-100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
At Julius Baer, we celebrate and value the individual qualities you bring, enabling you to be impactful, to be entrepreneurial, to be empowered, and to create value beyond wealth. Let’s shape the future of wealth management together.

For our Employee Compliance Team within Central Compliance, we are looking for a Specialist, Employee Conflicts Management to join our team. The team is responsible for the Conduct Framework, monitoring and promoting effective governance and ensuring highest standards of Compliance across our operations.

YOUR CHALLENGE

• Evolve the design, governance, and global implementation of the Employee Conflicts framework, ensuring alignment with evolving regulatory expectations, internal policies, and the Bank’s risk appetite

• Lead the design and operation of preventive controls for employee trading and conflict-of-interest frameworks, with accountability to Group Compliance and regulators

• Own and govern end-to-end processes including restricted lists, pre-clearance, and annual declarations, driving consistency and audit readiness

• Champion process improvements through automation and technology partnerships to increase efficiency, coverage, and risk detection

• Act as escalation point for suspected breaches; lead investigations and coordinate disciplinary actions in collaboration with HR and Line Management

• Advise Senior Management on conduct risks, personal trading restrictions, and mitigation measures — delivering pragmatic, principles-based guidance aligned with business realities

YOUR PROFILE

• Either a university degree in law, business, finance, or a related field or substantial professional experience in the banking sector, particularly in areas such as trading or trade surveillance

• Minimum of 5 years of relevant experience in a financial services environment, preferably within private banking or wealth management, with a solid understanding of market conduct principles and regulatory expectations

• Proven expertise in transaction monitoring and/or employee compliance, covering policy interpretation, breach assessments, investigative procedures and disciplinary recommendations

• Demonstrated interest in and contribution to the optimisation, automation and digitalisation of compliance processes – particularly in areas such as transaction monitoring, pre-clearance workflows or employee disclosure initiatives.

• Solid product and service knowledge within private banking, enabling accurate assessment of employee transactions in the context of complex instruments, investment products and advisory activities

• Proficient in Microsoft Office; experience with compliance systems, Workday, or trade surveillance platforms is an asset

• Fluent in English (written and spoken); German language skills are a distinct advantage

jobs.title: Assistant Relationship Manager 80 - 100% for Zurich Desk (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
At Julius Baer, we celebrate and value the individual qualities you bring, enabling you to be impactful, to be entrepreneurial, to be empowered, and to create value beyond wealth. Let’s shape the future of wealth management together.

The Assistant Relationship Manager (ARM) Private Banking supports one or more Relationship Manager(s) (RM)/ Team Head(s) (TH) in daily operations, administration, client care and relationship management. The ARM interacts with internal as well as external stakeholders, provides clients with relevant information and supports the RM in implementing customized solutions. Furthermore, the ARM acts as role model in bringing the best service quality to the RMs/TH in a fast, professional and friendly manner, always living the Julius Baer values (Care, Passion and Excellence) and thus helping the team to manage and grow its current client base. He/she channels client feedback to the relevant individuals/departments within the Bank to foster continuous improvement and fast adaptation of processes. This position is the backbone of Client Relationship Management.

YOUR CHALLENGE
Client Administration & Management

• Supports RMs/TH in client interaction and all related tasks (systems, processes, files, documents etc.) with high-quality, precision and timely responsiveness

• Customizes client requests (reporting, statistics, mailings etc.)

• Manages the RM/TH’s calendar, prepares client meetings, organizes business trips, completes the post processing of client calls, client meetings or business trips for RMs/TH

• Compiles presentations, supports in drafting investment  proposals and in marketing activities if needed (client reception, meetings, business trips, events etc.)

• Ensures coverage in case of own absences

Business Management

• Regularly collects and exchanges relevant information necessary for the job

• Organises himself/herself in an efficient and compliant manner and ensures timely and appropriate information of the superior

• Conducts reviews, plans ahead and documents his/her work at all times

• Supports RM/TH in implementation of projects and initiatives

• Provides professional input proposals for improvements based on experience, incident occurrence or observation

• Manages the expense claim process for RMs/TH

Risk Management & Controls

• Actively helps managing risk (support first line of defence), i.e. in client documentation, by raising concerns, following up on issues and by escalating when in doubt

• Ensures adherence to local regulations and compliance with internal policies and standards (e.g. new account openings, payment instructions, reviewing client phone calls or signing off at own level of competence etc.) in collaboration with the respective RMs and TH

• Ensures timely clearance of pending items and escalated deficiencies

• Ensures appropriate ethical and compliant behaviour in his/her area of responsibility

• Ensures correct, meaningful and understandable documentation of client interaction/client orders in the corresponding tool (e.g. CRM, DiAS)

YOUR PROFILE
Personal & Social Skills

• Team player

• Excellent situational adaptability (able to work with RMs and clients from diverse backgrounds)

• Friendly, trustworthy and discreet personality with high level of risk awareness

• Highly service oriented and passionate about client servicing

• Always communicates in a friendly, competent and professional manner

• Open, approachable an displays genuine interest in people and in improving processes

• Systematic, precise and diligent working style and the ability to perform under pressure

• Personal integrity and ethical behaviour

Professional Skills

• Sound affinity with the geographic market(s) covered, i.e. familiar with the legal and regulatory environment as well as cultural awareness

• Good understanding of relevant products and services in Private Banking

• Basic knowledge of global financial markets and current developments in the industry

Education and Experience

• Relevant educational (bank apprenticeship or equivalent) and 3 - 5 years of professional experience in a similar role in the banking industry

• Fluency in German and English (verbal and written)

• Proven track record in servicing banking clients with complex needs (onboarding of new, maintaining and extending current relationships)

We are looking forward to receiving your full job application through our online application tool. Further interesting job opportunities can be found on our Career site.

jobs.title: Senior Executive Assistant 100%, Zürich, (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
At Julius Baer, we celebrate and value the individual qualities you bring, enabling you to be impactful, to be entrepreneurial, to be empowered, and to create value beyond wealth. Let’s shape the future of wealth management together.

The Executive Assistant role supporting the Co-Market Head Switzerland is a critical position requiring a seasoned, discreet, and results-driven professional. Reporting directly to the senior leader of the Geneva office, this individual will provide comprehensive, high-calibre administrative and operational support, ensuring seamless day-to-day functioning across priorities.

The successful candidate will support the Co-Market Head Switzerland in driving operational efficiency, strategic initiatives, and leadership coordination across the Swiss market, with a particular focus on the development and growth of the Geneva branch. This role combines high-level administrative support with some core business management responsibilities, acting as a trusted partner to ensure seamless execution of priorities.

This individual will serve as a pivotal point of contact, managing complex and diverse tasks such as executive support, business management, Geneva branch development support and compliance related activities.

With a proactive mindset and unwavering attention to detail, the Executive Assistant will act as a trusted partner, anticipating needs, managing sensitive information with confidentiality, and contributing to enhanced executive effectiveness.

At Julius Baer, where excellence and client focus define our culture, this role demands the highest standards of professionalism, discretion, and service orientation in a fast-paced, multi-stakeholder environment.

YOUR CHALLENGE

• Manage the Co-Market Head’s calendar proactively: schedule meetings, prioritise appointments, and resolve conflicts

• Prepare agendas, briefing materials, presentations (PowerPoint/Excel), and talking points for internal and external meetings

• Organise travel arrangements, including itineraries, visa requirements if applicable, accommodations, and expense reporting

• Serve as gatekeeper by screening calls and emails, handling sensitive correspondence, and ensuring timely follow-up

• Act as liaison between headquarters and the Geneva office, ensuring alignment on policies, communications, and change initiatives

• Collaborate with all the key internal stakeholders, including Compliance and Legal departments when required, particularly regarding documentation and approvals

• Monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) for the Geneva branch; compile weekly/monthly reports

• Facilitate internal governance processes: organise regional management committee meetings, track action items, and maintain meeting minutes and follow-ups

• Assist in executing local growth strategies under guidance of the Co-Market Head

• Identify opportunities for process improvements and digital transformation

• Maintain strict confidentiality of all matters

YOUR PROFILE

• Bachelor’s degree in business administration, International Relations, or a related field

• Minimum of 5 years’ experience in an executive support or business coordination role, preferably within private banking or financial services

• Ability to travel regularly between Zürich and Geneva

• Proven ability to work effectively in a senior executive environment with discretion and professionalism

• Strong understanding of wealth management business models, organisational structures, and key drivers of performance

• Fluency in English and German (written and spoken); French language skills are a strong advantage

• Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint)

• Organisational Excellence: Ability to multitask efficiently while maintaining accuracy and attention to detail

• Initiative & Problem-Solving: Anticipates needs and proposes solutions without constant supervision

• Communication Skills: Clear, concise, and diplomatic communicator across levels and cultures.

• Team Collaboration: Works well both independently and as part of cross-functional teams

• Discretion & Integrity: Handles confidential information with utmost sensitivity and trustworthiness

We are looking forward to receiving your full job application through our online application tool. Further interesting job opportunities can be found on our Career site.

• Maintain strict confidentiality of all matters

• Bachelor’s degree in business administration, International Relations, or a related field

• Minimum of 5 years’ experience in an executive support or business coordination role, preferably within private banking or financial services

• Ability to travel regularly between Zürich and Geneva

• Proven ability to work effectively in a senior executive environment with discretion and professionalism

• Strong understanding of wealth management business models, organisational structures, and key drivers of performance

• Fluency in English and German (written and spoken); French language skills are a strong advantage

• Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint)

• Organisational Excellence: Ability to multitask efficiently while maintaining accuracy and attention to detail

• Initiative & Problem-Solving: Anticipates needs and proposes solutions without constant supervision

• Communication Skills: Clear, concise, and diplomatic communicator across levels and cultures.

• Team Collaboration: Works well both independently and as part of cross-functional teams

• Discretion & Integrity: Handles confidential information with utmost sensitivity and trustworthiness

jobs.title: Account Manager Intermediaries 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
At Julius Baer, we celebrate and value the individual qualities you bring, enabling you to be impactful, to be entrepreneurial, to be empowered, and to create value beyond wealth. Let’s shape the future of wealth management together.

In addition to the Assistant Relationship Manager (ARM) Intermediaries & Family Offices role profile, the Account Manager Intermediaries & Family Offices (AM INT) takes ownership of the account administration, documentation formalities and tasks in daily operations and projects impacting the account administration. In contrast to the Relationship Manager (RM), the AM INT does not have an own client book. The AM INT reaches out to clients where appropriate in close collaboration with the RM. He/she demonstrates excellent professional, personal as well as social skills when liaising with clients and the RM. The AM INT ensures the operational client account management and interacts with internal as well as external stakeholders independently, provides clients with relevant in- formation and supports the RM in implementing customized solutions. Furthermore, the AM INT acts as role model in bringing the best service quality to clients, RMs and Team Heads (THs) in a fast, professional and friendly manner, always living the Julius Baer values (Care, Passion, and Excellence) and thus, helping the team to manage and grow its current client base. He/she channels client feedback to the relevant individuals and departments within the Bank to foster continuous improvement and fast adaptation of processes. The AM INT shows professional commitment to ensuring excellent administration of the account, to clients as well as to the Bank and is willing to go the extra mile.

YOUR CHALLENGE
Client Administration & Management

• Ensures that accurate and high-quality client relationship documentation formalities are always met and maintained to a high standard including client identification documentation (CDB), account opening forms and other relevant legal forms

• Actively ensures that operational account management is undertaken professionally, with all tasks/system alerts cleared directly where possible or via RM if necessary

• Where appropriate is part of client meetings and even leads parts of the meeting (e.g. documentation formalities, compliance, other requests of the client) if case allows

• Actively maintains client key data in liaison with the RM to ensure CRM and other data sets are correct for good maintenance of the relationship

• Interacts with clients in an independent and professional manner in all aspects of account management

• Proactively takes the lead in supporting the RMs/TH in client relationship and all related tasks (systems, applications, processes, documents etc.), with high-quality, precision and timely responsiveness

• Ensures operational coverage and client interaction (not advice) within the team during absences

• Creates and provides clients with customized information, reports and statistics, etc.

YOUR PROFILE
Personal and Social Skills

• Excellent situational adaptability (able to work with RMs and clients from diverse backgrounds)

• Friendly, trustworthy and discreet personality with a high level of risk awareness

• Proactive and independent work approach

• Positive “can do” attitude and approaches challenges with an open mind

• Takes on extra responsibilities at own initiative

• Highly service oriented and passionate about client servicing

• Exceptional communication skills and always communicates in a friendly, competent and professional manner

• Aims for excellence by finding ways to do things smarter, faster, better and is also not afraid to question a status quo

• Systematic, precise and diligent working style and the ability to perform exceedingly well under pressure

• Team player

• High personal integrity and ethical behaviour

• Is a go-to person by e.g. helping colleagues, training other assistants, participating in the “Buddy Programme”

Professional & Technical Skills

• Sound affinity with the geographic market(s) covered, i.e. familiar with the legal and regulatory environment as well as cultural awareness

• Profound understanding of relevant products, services as well as tools in Intermediaries & Family Offices

• Advanced knowledge of global financial markets and current developments in the industry

Education & Experience

• Either at least 5 years of experience as ARM or 3 years of experience as ARM and job-related higher degree (e.g. Bachelor, CFA/AZEK/CAIA), without counting the apprenticeship period

• Excellent language skills (verbal and written) in English and Mandarin. German and French a plus.

• Proven track record in servicing banking clients with complex needs (on boarding of new clients, maintaining and extending current relationships)

• Successful completion of applicable internal AM Intermediaries & FO training programme

jobs.title: Sustainability Business Analyst, 100%, Zürich (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
At Julius Baer, we celebrate and value the individual qualities you bring, enabling you to be impactful, to be entrepreneurial, to be empowered, and to create value beyond wealth. Let’s shape the future of wealth management together.

Are you passionate about turning complex data into clear insights that support strategic decision-making? Do you enjoy compiling and analysing sustainability-related data, assessing sustainability impacts, risks and opportunities, and translating your findings into actionable insights? Are you confident in preparing high-quality internal and external reports and developing concise decision materials for senior leadership, including the Sustainability Committee, Executive Board, and Board of Directors?

YOUR CHALLENGE

• Support the implementation and monitoring of the Bank’s sustainability strategy through data analysis, providing a basis for senior management decision making, progress tracking and reporting

• Create concise, decision-oriented materials for senior management, including the Sustainability Committee, Executive Board, and Board of Directors

• Develop and maintain sustainability dashboards and management scorecards, providing data-driven insights to senior management and enabling effective tracking of progress against sustainability-related strategic priorities

• Contribute to the enhancement of sustainability reporting frameworks and processes, and conduct sustainability assessments, including greenhouse gas (GHG) accounting, ensuring accuracy and compliance with regulatory and industry requirements

• Support environmental and climate risk assessments, including the identification and evaluation of sustainability-related impacts, risks and opportunities

• Support the preparation of the Bank’s non-financial disclosures by managing data collection, validation, and consolidation, ensuring data quality, audit readiness, and compliance with relevant reporting standards (e.g., CSRD, TCFD)

• Coordinate and complete annual questionnaires and disclosures for key industry standards and ratings (e.g., UN-PRI, MSCI)

YOUR PROFILE

• Strong quantitative and analytical skills, with the ability to transform complex data into actionable business insights

• Ability to translate complex analyses into concise, impactful presentations for senior management

• 3–5 years of relevant professional experience, and university degree (Master’s preferred) in finance, economics, data analytics, environmental science, or a related field

• Experience or academic exposure to sustainability reporting, GHG accounting, ESG analysis, or environmental assessments is an advantage

• Strong interest in financial markets, investment trends, and the banking industry, ideally within wealth management

• Strong attention to detail with a structured, reliable and quality-focused approach to work

• Proficiency in data analysis and visualisation tools (e.g., Excel, Tableau, Python), familiarity with AI-enabled analytics, sustainability data platforms is an advantage

• Proactive and collaborative team player with strong communication and stakeholder management skills

Learn more about the Sustainability Team
Creating value beyond wealth is Julius Baer’s purpose. We aim to empower clients, employees, and broader stakeholder groups to make a positive and lasting impact. To achieve this, the Sustainability Team drives the Bank’s sustainability strategy, covering both client-focused solutions and services as well as our own corporate activities. We work closely with internal stakeholders across the Bank, as well as with clients, investors, and external partners, to embed sustainability into decision-making and business practices.

jobs.title: Intermediate Security Engineer Logging SIEM Data Pipelines 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
At Julius Baer, we celebrate and value the individual qualities you bring, enabling you to be impactful, to be entrepreneurial, to be empowered, and to create value beyond wealth. Let’s shape the future of wealth management together.

We are seeking an intermediate security data engineer with deep expertise in SIEM platforms, telemetry pipelines, and security operations tooling to join our global team in Zurich. As the ideal candidate, you combine strong security foundations with a data engineering mindset and are comfortable architecting and operating high-volume, enterprise-scale logging and analytics infrastructure in a regulated financial services environment. You are proactive, technically curious, and thrive in both independent and collaborative work settings.

Your primary responsibilities will involve designing, operating, and evolving our centralised logging and SIEM platforms, building and maintaining data pipelines for intelligent log routing and enrichment, driving SOAR automation, and contributing to the expansion of our security data ecosystem — including early-stage observability use cases. You will work closely with security operations, infrastructure, and application teams to ensure reliable, high-quality data flows from source to insight.

YOUR CHALLENGE

• As part of a dedicated team, architect, operate, and continuously improve the Bank’s centralised logging and SIEM platforms, ensuring high availability, performance, and scalability for enterprise-grade data volumes

• Design, build, and maintain telemetry and data pipelines, enabling routing, enrichment, filtering, and multi-destination delivery of security and operational log data while maintaining cost-efficiency

• Drive the development and operationalisation of SOAR workflows to accelerate incident response, automate repetitive tasks, and improve security operations efficiency

• Develop and maintain service monitoring, detection content, reports, and dashboards that provide actionable security intelligence to stakeholders across the organisation

• Collaborate with security operations, IT infrastructure, and application teams to integrate new data sources, ensure data quality, and expand platform coverage — including early-stage contributions to observability use cases

• Maintain technical documentation including architecture descriptions, runbooks, data flow diagrams, and security parameterisations

• Coordinate the mitigation or resolution of security-relevant platform incidents with internal security stakeholders and external vendors

• Contribute to the development of architecture, standards, and best practices for the centralised logging and telemetry ecosystem

• Provide 2nd and 3rd level engineering support, including participation in an on-call rotation ​

YOUR PROFILE

• Comfortable working across multiple application, infrastructure, and business teams

• Willingness and curiosity to learn new technologies and approaches in a rapidly evolving landscape Highly proactive, solution-oriented, and results-driven with strong abstract and conceptual thinking skills

• Structured and goal-oriented approach to work, with the ability to independently assess, prioritise, and resolve complex tasks and requests

• Creative problem solver who challenges the status quo and proposes innovative solutions to existing issues

• Strong communicator who can translate technical complexity into clear guidance for platform users, stakeholders, and cross-functional teams

• Contribute to the development of architecture, concepts, and processes related to the Centralised Logging and Telemetry ecosystem

• University degree or higher technical education (university of applied sciences, federal diploma) in Computer Science, Information Security, or related discipline — or equivalent practical experience

• Minimum 5 years of hands-on experience engineering and administering enterprise SIEM platforms, with experience developing detection content, correlation searches, dashboards, and CIM-normalised data models

• Strong experience designing and operating data pipelines and log routing infrastructure, ideally with Cribl Stream or comparable telemetry pipeline tools

• Practical scripting and automation skills with one or more of: Python, Bash/Shell, JavaScript

• Working experience with GIT, SQL, REST APIs, and regular expressions

• Solid understanding of SOAR platforms and security operations automation

• Experience with configuration management tools such as Ansible is an advantage

• Fluent written and spoken English (B2/C1)

We are looking forward to receiving your full job application through our online application tool. Further interesting job opportunities can be found on our Career site.

jobs.title: Data Leakage Prevention (DLP) Specialist 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
At Julius Baer, we celebrate and value the individual qualities you bring, enabling you to be impactful, to be entrepreneurial, to be empowered, and to create value beyond wealth. Let’s shape the future of wealth management together.

At Julius Baer, we value the deep understanding of banking operations and client-centric processes that our people bring — both are essential to protect sensitive information in an increasingly complex and data-driven environment. As the importance of strong data protection practices continue to grow across the financial industry, we are expanding our Data Leakage Prevention (DLP) capabilities to further strengthen the Bank's security posture.

Based in Zurich and operating within the Group CISO & Technology Risk Control function of the CRO division, we are looking for a DLP specialist who combines strong business knowledge with solid analytical skills and a keen sense for operational risks. In this role, you will play a central part in identifying and assessing potential data leakage incidents, ensuring that employees are guided effectively through remediation steps, and contributing to the continuous enhancement of our DLP controls and processes. Operating within an international environment, you will collaborate closely with DLP teams and stakeholders across multiple locations, helping to maintain a consistent and effective global DLP framework that safeguards both our clients and the Organization.

YOUR CHALLENGE

• Assess DLP alerts for potential data leaks, communicate with users to guide  remediation actions, and reinforce secure data-handling practices.

• Identify opportunities to improve DLP processes and playbooks to increase efficiency.

• Turn DLP alerts data into actionable insights by identifying trends and anomalies, and shaping KPIs and KRIs to strengthen risk oversight across the Bank.

• Provide guidance on DLP policy interpretation and support their refinement based on risk, operational insights, and business needs, while enhancing detection accuracy, reducing operational disruption, and maintaining strong data protection.

• Foster consistent DLP practices across global teams by sharing insights and promoting collaboration and learning.

YOUR PROFILE

• Strong understanding of banking operations, client processes and data flows, and how they relate to DLP risks.

• Hands-on experience with security monitoring or incident management, preferably with Data Leakage Prevention (DLP) tools or other security detection technologies.

• Ability to communicate clearly and confidently, especially when explaining incidents to non-technical stakeholders, guiding them through remediation steps and influencing secure behaviour.

• Experience in information security, risk management, compliance, data protection or audit, ideally within the financial industry, with exposure to regulatory expectations around information security and/or data governance.

• Solid analytical and data-interpretation skills, with the ability to identify patterns, anomalies and underlying risk indicators in data. Experience with analytics or visualization tools is a strong advantage.

• Relevant academic background in Business Administration, Information Security, Computer Science, or a related field. Industry certifications are an asset.

• Proficiency in German, French and/or Italian is a plus, enabling effective communication across the Bank's key locations and supporting collaboration with stakeholders in multiple regions.

We are looking forward to receiving your full job application through our online application tool. Further interesting job opportunities can be found on our Career site.

jobs.title: Data / ETL Engineer – People Analytics 80% - 100% (f/m/d) - (Contract through our external payroll partner with immediate start for 8 months)
jobs.description:
At Julius Baer, we celebrate and value the individual qualities you bring, enabling you to be impactful, to be entrepreneurial, to be empowered, and to create value beyond wealth. Let’s shape the future of wealth management together.

Join the People Analytics team to support the expansion of our HR data platform, focusing on data pipeline refactoring, integrations, and onboarding new data sources.

You will work with Workday, Dataiku, Tableau, and Trino/Presto to ensure scalable, automated, and high-quality data flows.

YOUR CHALLENGE

Data Engineering / ETL pipelines

• Build and refactor existing ETL/ELT pipelines with focus on reliability, performance, and maintainability

• Specifically, integrate data from CFO (SAP BW / S/4HANA) into the HR data warehouse; collaborate with Finance stakeholders to understand and translate data into People Analytics–ready datasets

Integrations & Connectors

• Develop and enhance data integrations and connectors (python) across the technology stack (Workday, Dataiku, Tableau)

• Standardize integration patterns and reduce technical debt

Drive & Collaboration

• Proactively drive your projects coordinating with colleagues across with HR and Finance

YOUR PROFILE

• Strong experience in data engineering / ETL / modelling with focus on pipelines maintainability and data quality practices

• Proven Python skills for data pipelines and integrations

• Experience with Dataiku or similar platforms (Databricks, Airflow, etc.)

• Experience in Banking / Finance industry and familiarity with SAP (BW/S4) are a plus

• You are hands-on, a self-starter, with strong stakeholder management, and structured ways of working

jobs.title: Intern Regional CFO Emerging Markets 100% (f/m/d) - 6-12months
jobs.description:
At Julius Baer, we celebrate and value the individual qualities you bring, enabling you to be impactful, to be entrepreneurial, to be empowered, and to create value beyond wealth. Let’s shape the future of wealth management together.

The regional CFO team for Emerging Markets (reporting to the Group CFO) provides overall finance management to the region head related to key front topics and requires a broad skillset from both analytical and interpersonal level.

YOUR CHALLENGE

• Act as partner to the business: Project management for product or finance related requests (e.g. loans, subsidies, rates programs, capital/funding analysis, pricing analysis, etc.).

• Maintain and improve the monitoring of initiatives with full responsibility for reconciliations

• Strategic finance topics: Support monthly financial reporting processes and provide commentary for Senior Management; contribute towards financial planning for the Region and Markets and/or bigger local legal entities; work alongside Corporate Development team on M&A projects

• Ad hoc finance deep dives: Analysis for specific senior management requests (e.g. Net New Money, local business transformation plans, strategic finance developments, etc.)

• Drive transformation projects for strategic finance topics: Assist financial planning through financial modelling and identify & drive implementation of ongoing enhancements for the purpose of performance steering

YOUR PROFILE

• University student (Bachelor or Master level) or recent graduate

• Initial practical experience in finance or corporate finance and/or wealth management is a plus

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills and capacity for conceptual thinking

• Proactive and with ability to work independently

• “Can-do-attitude” coupled with openness to challenges and willingness to learn

• Proficient user in MS Office applications, especially Excel and PowerPoint

• Strong communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills

• Fluency in English is a requirement (spoken and written), German and other languages meritorious

jobs.title: Operation Specialist - Cash Management 100% (f/m/d) - (Contract through our external payroll partner with immediate start for 12 months with possible extension)
jobs.description:
At Julius Baer, we celebrate and value the individual qualities you bring, enabling you to be impactful, to be entrepreneurial, to be empowered, and to create value beyond wealth. Let’s shape the future of wealth management together.

We are seeking a detail-oriented professional to manage daily cash and settlement operations, ensuring accurate funding, liquidity movements, and reconciliation across asset classes. In this role, you will perform critical control functions, support global initiatives, identify process improvements, and uphold strict compliance with operational risk and regulatory standards.

YOUR CHALLENGE

• Execute day-to-day Cash Management as well as FX/MM & PM settlement and post-settlement activities

• Daily cash management tasks, including funding, liquidity movements, cash sweeps and account balancing

• Identify and resolve reconciliation breaks in positions across multiple asset classes

• Execute cash sweep operations according to predefined mandates and timelines

• Report daily cash balances accurately and on time

• Actively contribute to local and global initiatives as a Subject Matter Expert

• Perform control tasks following the 4-eye principle, in accordance with defined standards

• Adhere strictly to internal guidelines, policies, and compliance requirements

• Demonstrate strong awareness of operational risk

• Conduct regular controls, and promptly report incidents or system-related issues

• Provide reliable support by responding to ad-hoc queries and delivering timely, accurate feedback

• Initiate and propose improvement ideas to enhance efficiency, quality, and risk mitigation

YOUR PROFILE

• Successful completion of a bank apprenticeship or comparable vocational training preferred

• Prior exposure to banking operations or a financial services environment is highly desirable

• Advanced proficiency in MS Office tools, particularly Excel

• Fluent in both German and English (written and spoken)

• High level of risk awareness, particularly in relation to operational risks

• Reliable and accountable professional with a proactive, solution-oriented mindset

• Strong interpersonal skills and a service-oriented attitude

• Independent, precise, and structured in approach, with ability to work autonomously

• Open to continuous learning and development; keen to embrace change and improvement

YOUR CHALLENGE

• Ensure a high service level by taking over  IT Service Owner role for the remote access infrastructure based on Citrix Netscaler

• Configuring and optimising NetScaler appliances for high availability, scalability, and performance

jobs.title: Senior Business Auditor – Global Products & Solutions with focus on Trading, Product Sales and Execution Activities - Group Internal Audit 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
At Julius Baer, we celebrate and value the individual qualities you bring, enabling you to be impactful, to be entrepreneurial, to be empowered, and to create value beyond wealth. Let’s shape the future of wealth management together.

Julius Baer is the leading Swiss private banking group with a focus on servicing and advising sophisticated private clients and a premium brand in global wealth management. That is why a comprehensive range of services and first-class service quality are essential – as are the committed teams that provide them.
Group Internal Audit (GIA) is an independent function that provides assurance to the Board of Directors and to the Audit Committee. We conduct our work by assessing the Bank’s ability to manage and control risks and advise the functions on how to enhance their risk management capabilities. We report directly to the Chairman of the Board and the Audit Committee.
For our Global Products & Solutions Audit Team based in Zurich (Head Quarter), we are looking for a full-time (100%) Senior Internal Auditor.

YOUR CHALLENGE
As an experienced auditor in the Global Products & Solutions area, you will lead end-to-end audits covering trading, product sales and execution activities in Switzerland and, when required, internationally.

Key responsibilities include:

• Leading the planning and execution of risk-based audits, including scoping, fieldwork, reporting, and follow-up

• Developing comprehensive audit plans with clearly defined objectives and risk focus

• Ensuring audit assignments are completed on time, within budget, and in full compliance with internal audit standards and methodology

• Independently assessing the materiality and impact of findings

• Conducting mandated participant audits for exchanges such as SIX Swiss Exchange and BX Swiss AG, verifying compliance with related exchange regulations and the Financial Market Infrastructure Act (FMIA)

• Preparing formal audit reports in English, communicating findings clearly and constructively

• Presenting actionable insights and recommendations to stakeholders at all levels, including Senior Management, and proactively monitoring remediation progress

• Applying data analytics techniques to enhance testing coverage, objectivity, and efficiency

• Contributing to special assignments, including ad-hoc reviews, investigations, and deep dives

jobs.title: Senior Test Manager & Quality Engineer 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
At Julius Baer, we celebrate and value the individual qualities you bring, enabling you to be impactful, to be entrepreneurial, to be empowered, and to create value beyond wealth. Let’s shape the future of wealth management together.

Join our ML & AI ART as a Test Manager & Quality Engineer responsible for testing AI & ML solutions throughout their life-cycle. Focus will be on assessing the quality of developed solutions already in the development phase and give active feedback/collaborate with the ML Engineer teams.

You are the gatekeeper before a solution goes into evaluation by Model Risk Management and also before Go-Live. You will also own the testing and quality assurance of technical components that are provided by the platform team such as model APIs, agent repository and other components. implementation, and execution of our test automation frameworks, covering both traditional software components

YOUR CHALLENGE

• Ensure delivery quality and proper testing of AI use cases

• Define and evolve the technical testing approach and framework architecture for the ML & AI ART, aligned with the Bank's Test Strategy and Test Policy

• Design reusable, scalable testing patterns (page objects, API clients, test data builders) that other engineers across squads can adopt, ensuring technical consistency of testing across the ART

• Analyse and evaluate requirements, Features, and Stories for testability during PI Planning, Backlog Refinement, and Iteration Planning

• Derive test cases from technical and risk analysis of both functional and non-functional requirements (reliability, performance, security, usability, robustness), selecting appropriate test techniques and automation scope based on risk, coverage goals, and ROI

• Automate identified test cases using Python-based frameworks — Playwright-Python for UI, requests + pytest for APIs, Behave or pytest-bdd for BDD/Gherkin — applying clean code principles, reusability, readability, and stability

• Design and implement AI/ML-specific test cases: evaluation pipelines for LLM outputs

• Integrate and orchestrate automated tests in GitLab CI/CD pipelines, including merge request pipelines, GitLab runner

• Plan, schedule, and trigger automated test executions across environments (DEV, INT, UAT, pre-PROD) including regression suites, smoke tests, release executions, and on-demand runs tied to merge requests and PI milestones

• Triage execution results, raise defects in Jira with evidence (logs, traces, screenshots, videos), and communicate quality signals to the squad and Product Owner

• Contribute actively to PI Planning, System Demos, Inspect & Adapt, and other SAFe ceremonies as part of the ML & AI ART

• Prepare test data, ensuring synthetic or anonymised data is used wherever possible to meet confidentiality expectations

YOUR PROFILE

• Hands-on experience integrating and executing tests for AI solutions and/or large scale data projects

• Solid grasp of Git and version control workflows, clean code principles, and code review culture

• Working knowledge of Docker; familiarity with Kubernetes basics (jobs, namespaces)

• Exposure to testing AI/ML systems, or strong motivation to develop this expertise: evaluation of LLM outputs, handling non-deterministic responses, evals for RAG and agentic workflow

• Understanding of API design, microservices, event-driven architectures, and authentication layers

• Sound understanding of SAFe and DevOps principles; experience operating in an Agile Release Train is a plus

• Experience with Jira for Story/Feature tracking and test management integration (Xray, Agile Hive)

• Demonstrated end-to-end thinking — connecting user journeys, data flows, authentication layers, and system boundaries

• Comfortable working within an established Test Strategy, collaborating with Test Managers on execution planning, reporting, and compliance

• Collaborative team player with strong ownership takes automation problems from analysis to execution to resolution with minimal supervision

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field

• Minimum 5–7 years with data & ML platforms and their Quality Assurance and/or Testing with substantial hands-on Python experience, including demonstrated framework design, ownership, and test execution at scale (not only script-level contributions)

• Experience in a regulated environment (financial services, healthcare, pharma) strongly preferred

• Certifications in ISTQB (Foundation as baseline)

• SAFe (SP, SSM, or equivalent), or DevOps disciplines are a plus

• Exposure to AI/ML systems through testing, development, or applied projects is a strong plus; appetite to develop deep AI/ML testing expertise is essential

• Strong communicator able to work effectively with engineers, Product Owners and Scrum Masters

• Good organisational skills, structured and reliable

• Fluency in English; German is a plus

jobs.description:
At Julius Baer, we celebrate and value the individual qualities you bring, enabling you to be impactful, to be entrepreneurial, to be empowered, and to create value beyond wealth. Let’s shape the future of wealth management together.

We are seeking an experienced Senior Frontend Engineer Frontend Developer to join our dynamic team at a leading financial institution in Zurich, Switzerland.

In this role, you will play a key part in the frontend migration of mission critical financial platforms, driving technical excellence.

You bring deep expertise in JavaScript/TypeScript and React, combined with strong engineering judgment, a passion for high quality user experiences, and a solid understanding of enterprise scale systems in regulated environments.

YOUR CHALLENGE

• Take ownership of complex frontend solutions, ensuring scalability, performance, security, and long‑term maintainability

• Partner closely with UX/UI designers and business stakeholders to translate complex requirements into intuitive, high‑quality user experiences

• Deliver high‑quality, production‑grade React and TypeScript code for complex financial applications

• Address advanced frontend challenges such as state management, performance optimization, and integration with distributed backend systems

• Proactively refactor and modernize existing codebases where required

• Support troubleshooting and root‑cause analysis in both development and production environments

• Contribute actively in an agile, fast‑paced, and highly collaborative environment

YOUR PROFILE

• Extensive, hands‑on experience in JavaScript and TypeScript, with a strong focus on React at enterprise scale

• Deep understanding of modern frontend ecosystems, tools, and frameworks (React, Node.js, build tooling)

• Proven experience working with design systems and large, shared component libraries

• Solid understanding of Unix/Linux environments and bash scripting

• Experience in the financial services or other highly regulated industries is a plus

• Experience with cloud platforms, preferably Microsoft Azure

• Knowledge of microservices architecture and containerization (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes)

• Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices

• Exposure to API security, OAuth2, and related standards

• Excellent analytical, decision‑making, and problem‑solving skills

• Strong communication skills, a proactive mindset, and the ability to influence technical direction

• Proven ability to thrive in agile, cross‑functional teams

jobs.title: (Junior) Sanction Advisory 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
At Julius Baer, we celebrate and value the individual qualities you bring, enabling you to be impactful, to be entrepreneurial, to be empowered, and to create value beyond wealth. Let’s shape the future of wealth management together.

For strengthening our Global Sanctions Advisory Desk as part of the Compliance Department based in Zurich, we are looking for an eager, experienced, and team-minded Sanctions Compliance Officer with great care, passion, and excellence to work on challenges and tasks, being welcomed and joined by a professional and well-diversified team.

The Global Sanctions Desk covers Group Sanctions Compliance within Financial Crime Compliance (FCC) at the Head Office of Julius Bär. Its main responsibilities include the execution, maintenance, and enhancement of the group-wide Sanctions Compliance programme in close collaboration with all relevant internal functions and local Compliance units across the group affiliates, counterparties, authorities, and peers within the financial sector’s network.

Economic and trade sanctions imposed by governments promote national and international security and policy goals. Julius Baer Group implemented measures to ensure compliance with applicable sanctions requirements as well as to reduce or eliminate the exposure to sanctions as well as regulatory and reputational risks. The Group Sanctions Policy defines the responsibilities, global minimum standards, and measures regarding the Group’s compliance with applicable sanctions laws and regulations and key elements of relevant sanctions programmes.

YOUR CHALLENGE

• Defines and handles clients with sanctions nexus and conducts materiality assessment for making decisions on relevant risk aspects

• Assessment and handling of all aspects of sanctioned parties (SDN) with relationship to the bank

• Supports the team as center of competence in performing daily tasks

• Supports the application of sanctions laws and regulations as well as relevant sanctions programmes and implementation of specific measures at Head Office and throughout Julius Bär Group

• Advises colleagues in the implementation of the Global Sanctions Policy and monitors legal and regulatory developments

• Exchanges with local Compliance units across Group affiliates to ensure know-how transfer regarding policy decisions, controls, and material developments

• Interacts with counterparties, authorities, and peers within the financial sector’s network

YOUR PROFILE

• University degree (Bachelor or Master), preferable in Economics, Legal, Audit, or Finance, another higher education with a strong career development or completed bank apprenticeship in the financial sector with corresponding further education

• 3-5 years of professional experience, preferably in Compliance, Risk, Audit, Legal, with experience and knowledge in Sanctions

• Readiness to work in a rapidly changing and challenging environment and willingness to learn

• A team player with a strong personality who provides practical solutions, completes tasks independently, efficiently, reliably and with the necessary quality

• Very good organizational, operational, analytical and communication skills and ability to work under pressure

• Exhibition of sound judgment and strong sense of integrity and discretion

• Fluent written and spoken language skills in English, German would be beneficial and knowledge of further languages is an advantage

We are looking forward to receiving your full job application through our online application tool. Further interesting job opportunities can be found on our Career site.

jobs.description:
At Julius Baer, we celebrate and value the individual qualities you bring, enabling you to be impactful, to be entrepreneurial, to be empowered, and to create value beyond wealth. Let’s shape the future of wealth management together.

YOUR CHALLENGE

YOUR PROFILE

• Academic background in Banking, Financials Law or Business Administration, or a related field – legal education or qualification is a strong advantage

• Solid understanding of banking operations, ideally gained through prior experience in private banking, compliance, or audit

• Advanced proficiency in Excel and data analysis; experienced in structuring, cleaning, and interpreting datasets

• Strong competence in PowerPoint: ability to translate complex information into clear, visually compelling slides and summaries

• Experience in reporting, process coordination, or compliance support roles is highly desirable

• Exceptional organisational skills, precision in execution, and strong attention to detail

• Natural collaborator with a can-do attitude, capable of thriving in a matrixed environment with multiple stakeholders

• Eager to learn quickly, take initiative, and grow within a purpose-driven compliance function

jobs.description:
At Julius Baer, we celebrate and value the individual qualities you bring, enabling you to be impactful, to be entrepreneurial, to be empowered, and to create value beyond wealth. Let’s shape the future of wealth management together.

In this role, you will assist in the monthly preparation of regulatory reports for Bank Julius Baer & Co. Ltd. and Julius Baer Group Ltd. Most of your time will be dedicated to regulatory reporting operations activities, but you will also partake in project tasks.

YOUR CHALLENGE

Regulatory Reporting Operations (approx. 90%)

• Assist in the monthly preparation of regulatory reports for Bank Julius Baer & Co. Ltd. and Julius Baer Group Ltd.

• Perform reconciliations and quality checks of the monthly financial data for submission to SNB and FINMA, including capital and liquidity calculations

• Prepare ad hoc analyses and special reports, including narrative commentary

• Support in the preparation of the single credit registry (Einzelkrediterhebung EKE)

• Documentation of the closing processes, primarily in English

• Provide specialist Regulatory Reporting support to international locations worldwide

• Ensure ongoing compliance with internal controls

Project Tasks (approx. 10%)

• Supporting functional specifications and testing of functional and technical adaptations in the Regulatory Reporting application (Axiom)

• Support the implementation of new regulatory requirements in respect of SNB statistical reporting, capital adequacy, and liquidity reporting

• Analyse and continuously optimise existing processes

YOUR PROFILE

• Education in finance or business administration

• 3 years of professional experience in financial bank accounting essential

• Understanding of SNB statistical reporting is an advantage

• Proficiency in MS Office, experience with AxiomSL is beneficial

• Previous project experience is advantageous

• Very good English language skills, both written and spoken. Fluency in German is an advantage

• Strong analytical skills, with an independent, precise working style

• Team-oriented personality with a genuine interest in taking on new challenges

• High resilience and flexibility

• Monitoring and processing of price feeds and fixings for interest rate and inflation-linked products

• Monitoring of payment schedules and execution of payments

• Responding to operational queries and ad-hoc requests from key stakeholders, including Trading Desks, Relationship Managers, and other Operations teams

jobs.description:

• Help design, implement, and optimize new solutions within the performance management landscape

• Bring forward ideas to continuously improve processes, tools, and user experience

jobs.description:
At Julius Baer, we celebrate and value the individual qualities you bring, enabling you to be impactful, to be entrepreneurial, to be empowered, and to create value beyond wealth. Let’s shape the future of wealth management together.

The CIO Office Client Engagement function is responsible for bringing Julius Baer’s investment capabilities and the CIO Office value proposition to life through high-quality client-facing materials, formats, and experiences. The role plays a key part in enabling sales efforts, supporting campaigns and product initiatives, and promoting discretionary solutions through consistent and impactful communication.

We are looking for a dynamic professional to drive client engagement and marketing activities within the CIO Office, ensuring CIO initiatives and content are effectively activated across channels to support client conversations and commercial outcomes.

The Client Engagement Specialist acts as a key point of contact for priority client materials and initiatives, providing expertise on communication formats and activation strategies, and collaborates closely with portfolio managers, investment analysts, and client-facing teams to ensure relevance and strong sales enablement.

YOUR CHALLENGE

• Shape and execute CIO-aligned marketing and engagement initiatives, translating investment strategy and insights into client-relevant communication that supports sales and promotes discretionary solutions

• Design and deliver engaging content formats (e.g., newsletters, presentations, videos, webcasts, podcasts, events, digital content) to strengthen client discussions and sales conversations

• Produce, maintain and update high-quality client-facing materials and formats to actively promote discretionary solutions and investment insights

• Run marketing campaigns and product launches, ensuring effective positioning and adoption of discretionary offerings

• Monitor engagement, collect feedback, and track usage metrics to continuously improve effectiveness and commercial impact

• Contribute to the implementation of new tools and formats, including digital solutions and AI, to enhance efficiency and scalability

• Coordinate multi-channel content distribution (intranet, CRM, web, etc.) to maximize reach, engagement, and usage

• Stay current on market trends and the competitive landscape to shape content and marketing strategy

• Support internal education efforts and special projects that drive business growth

YOUR PROFILE

• University degree in marketing, business management, finance or equivalent field

• Strong understanding of investment products and financial markets

• 2-5 years of experience in delivering product marketing and client-facing content in a bank, asset manager or related financial services providers

• Excellent communication and storytelling skills, with the ability to simplify complex investment concepts into clear, engaging, and client‑friendly messaging

• Proven experience in content creation and multi-channel communication

• Results-oriented mindset with focus on measurable impact

• Team player with demonstrated ability to collaborate within a cross‑functional environment

• Proactive, creative and driven individual with a can-do mindset

• Exceptional English and German written and verbal communication skills, with a collaborative, solutions-oriented working style

• Willingness to drive innovation and improve processes, including effective use of technology/data/AI to increase quality, consistency, and speed

• Experience with Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign) is a plus

jobs.description:
At Julius Baer, we celebrate and value the individual qualities you bring, enabling you to be impactful, to be entrepreneurial, to be empowered, and to create value beyond wealth. Let’s shape the future of wealth management together.

At Julius Baer, we are committed to empowering our teams through a DevOps-driven approach. To achieve this, we are focused on developing scalable platforms that enable our product teams to self-serve their infrastructure and resource needs. As our application landscape evolves, we're investing in the expansion of our infrastructure automation capabilities.

Join our team as an Infrastructure Automation Expert and play a key role in designing and delivering automation solutions that drive efficiency across the organization by replacing manual processes with automated self-service offerings.

YOUR CHALLENGE

• Lead the design, development, and implementation of automation solutions using vRealize (Aria) Automation and/or Crossplane to streamline IT processes and improve efficiency

• Develop and maintain vRealize (Aria) Orchestrator workflows as well as develop Crossplane providers and functions using Golang and the Kubernetes Operator pattern

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure alignment with business objectives and technical strategies

• Provide technical leadership and expertise to the team, and contribute to the development of technical roadmaps and strategic plans

• Troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues related to vRealize Automation and Orchestration, and provide recommendations for improvements

• Stay up-to-date with the latest trends and technologies in cloud computing, virtualisation, and automation, and apply this knowledge to continuously improve our automation solutions

• Participate in the development of technical documentation, including design documents, implementation guides, and operational procedures

• Ensure compliance with industry standards, best practices, and organisational policies

YOUR PROFILE

• Minimum 2 years of experience developing and operating Kubernetes Operators, ideally using Golang and the Crossplane framework to provision and continuously reconcile resources

• Minimum 3 years of experience in designing, implementing, and managing automation solutions using vRealize (Aria) Automation, with a focus on large-scale enterprise environments

• Expert knowledge of Kubernetes and the cloud-native computing ecosystem

• Strong understanding of IT infrastructure including Windows, Linux, Active Directory, Cisco technologies, etc.

• Strong understanding of cloud computing, virtualisation, and automation technologies, including VMware vSphere, vCenter, and NSX

• Strong understanding of SW development processes, CI/CD pipelines and DevOps tools

• Strong understanding of IT service management frameworks such as ITIL, and experience with agile development methodologies and version control systems such as Git

• Experience with Golang and scripting languages such as Javascript, PowerShell or Python

• Proven track record of leading technical projects and teams, with experience in managing multiple stakeholders and vendors

• Excellent communication, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders

• Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and adapt to changing priorities and deadlines

• Ability to quickly grasp complex requirements, fast learner, highly proactive

• Proven track record in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field

jobs.description:
At Julius Baer, we celebrate and value the individual qualities you bring, enabling you to be impactful, to be entrepreneurial, to be empowered, and to create value beyond wealth. Let’s shape the future of wealth management together.

We are seeking a senior security data engineer with deep expertise in SIEM platforms, telemetry pipelines, and security operations tooling to join our global team in Zurich. As the ideal candidate, you combine strong security foundations with a data engineering mindset and are comfortable architecting and operating high-volume, enterprise-scale logging and analytics infrastructure in a regulated financial services environment. You are proactive, technically curious, and thrive in both independent and collaborative work settings.

Your primary responsibilities will involve designing, operating, and evolving our centralised logging and SIEM platforms, building and maintaining data pipelines for intelligent log routing and enrichment, driving SOAR automation, and contributing to the expansion of our security data ecosystem — including early-stage observability use cases. You will work closely with security operations, infrastructure, and application teams to ensure reliable, high-quality data flows from source to insight.

YOUR CHALLENGE

• As part of a dedicated team, architect, operate, and continuously improve the Bank’s centralised logging and SIEM platforms, ensuring high availability, performance, and scalability for enterprise-grade data volumes

• Design, build, and maintain telemetry and data pipelines, enabling routing, enrichment, filtering, and multi-destination delivery of security and operational log data while maintaining cost-efficiency

• Drive the development and operationalisation of SOAR workflows to accelerate incident response, automate repetitive tasks, and improve security operations efficiency

• Develop and maintain service monitoring, detection content, reports, and dashboards that provide actionable security intelligence to stakeholders across the organisation

• Collaborate with security operations, IT infrastructure, and application teams to integrate new data sources, ensure data quality, and expand platform coverage — including early-stage contributions to observability use cases

• Maintain technical documentation including architecture descriptions, runbooks, data flow diagrams, and security parameterisations

• Coordinate the mitigation or resolution of security-relevant platform incidents with internal security stakeholders and external vendors

• Contribute to the development of architecture, standards, and best practices for the centralised logging and telemetry ecosystem

• Provide 2nd and 3rd level engineering support, including participation in an on-call rotation

YOUR PROFILE

• Highly proactive, solution-oriented, and results-driven with strong abstract and conceptual thinking skills

• Structured and goal-oriented approach to work, with the ability to independently assess, prioritise, and resolve complex tasks and requests

• Creative problem solver who challenges the status quo and proposes innovative solutions to existing issues

• Strong communicator who can translate technical complexity into clear guidance for platform users, stakeholders, and cross-functional teams

• Contribute to the development of architecture, concepts, and processes related to the Centralised Logging and Telemetry ecosystem

• Comfortable working across multiple application, infrastructure, and business teams

• Willingness and curiosity to learn new technologies and approaches in a rapidly evolving landscape

• University degree or higher technical education (university of applied sciences, federal diploma) in Computer Science, Information Security, or related discipline — or equivalent practical experience

• Minimum 5 years of hands-on experience engineering and administering enterprise SIEM platforms, with experience developing detection content, correlation searches, dashboards, and CIM-normalised data models

• Strong experience designing and operating data pipelines and log routing infrastructure, ideally with Cribl Stream or comparable telemetry pipeline tools

• Practical scripting and automation skills with one or more of: Python, Bash/Shell, JavaScript

• Working experience with GIT, SQL, REST APIs, and regular expressions

• Solid understanding of SOAR platforms and security operations automation

• Experience with configuration management tools such as Ansible is an advantage

• Fluent written and spoken English

• Good knowledge of German is a strong plus

jobs.title: Application Integration Engineer 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
At Julius Baer, we celebrate and value the individual qualities you bring, enabling you to be impactful, to be entrepreneurial, to be empowered, and to create value beyond wealth. Let’s shape the future of wealth management together.

The Application Integration Engineer is responsible for the development, implementation, and operational support of FIX integration solutions and Order Trade Flows on the company’s Financial Messaging Infrastructure (BCOM). The role includes project participation, customer onboarding, monitoring and automation initiatives (meshIQ), and collaboration with both internal and external stakeholders.

YOUR CHALLENGE
Role Responsibilities:

FIX & Messaging Integration

• Develop, configure, and maintain FIX integrations using ITIVI APPIA FIX, IBM MQ, and IBM ACE

• Configure FIX sessions, protocol parameters, and connectivity for clients, brokers, and exchanges

• Develop and maintain message flows within the existing middleware architecture

• Design, coordinate, and execute FIX certification tests for onboarding clients and exchanges

Engineering & Project Support

• Support project requests from the Markets environment (Front Office, Trading, Brokerage)

• Analyze new client-specific requirements and design corresponding integration solutions

• Perform detailed root‑cause analysis in the event of production incidents

• Provide technical expertise during the client onboarding process

Operations & On‑Call Duty

• Ensure stable and continuous operation of the FIX and MQ messaging landscape

• Contribute to monitoring and automation initiatives using meshIQ products

• Participate in the team’s rotating 24/7 on‑call service

YOUR PROFILE
Education:

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science (university or university of applied sciences), or equivalent proven technical expertise

Technical Skills:

• 5+ years of hands‑on experience with the FIX protocol, including deep knowledge of Order/Trade Flows, FIX-Engine and Frameworks

• Solid Linux proficiency

• Programming skills in at least one language: ESQL, Bash, Perl, Java

• Strong experience with MQ client/broker connectivity and related industry standards

• Proven expertise in developing integration solutions in a banking environment using: IBM MQ, IBM Integration Bus (IIB), IBM ACE

• Experience with client and exchange connectivity in financial markets

• Good understanding of key financial products (Equities, FX, Derivatives)

• Knowledge of SWIFT (ISO20022 / MT / MX) is considered an advantage

Soft Skills:

• Strong communication skills with the ability to collaborate effectively with internal and external stakeholders

• Analytical mindset with structured problem‑solving capabilities

• Ability to work independently in both project environments and 24/7 operational settings

• Service‑oriented attitude and readiness to take ownership of technical issues

jobs.description:
At Julius Baer, we celebrate and value the individual qualities you bring, enabling you to be impactful, to be entrepreneurial, to be empowered, and to create value beyond wealth. Let’s shape the future of wealth management together.

As a Mortgage Officer, you will act as the second line of defense in mortgage underwriting and servicing for domestic and international private banking clients. You will assess credit risk, ensure compliance, and support the front line in delivering sound mortgage solutions. This interesting role combines risk oversight with operational excellence, requiring close collaboration with Mortgage Advisors, Relationship Managers, and internal stakeholders.

YOUR CHALLENGE

• Evaluate mortgage requests within personal approval authority, assessing borrower creditworthiness, collateral, and structural risks

• Provide qualified feedback and recommendations to Mortgage Advisors and Relationship Managers

• Ensure all transactions meet legal, regulatory, and internal requirements

• Perform servicing and lifecycle administration of active mortgage facilities, including modifications and renewals

• Drive data quality improvements across current and new mortgage positions

• Contribute to process optimisation and operational excellence in close cooperation with stakeholders

• Maintain regular contact with Mortgage Advisors, the Julius Baer Real Estate Team, and Relationship Managers to support efficient transaction execution

YOUR PROFILE

• Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Business, or related field; or relevant professional experience considered

• 3–5+ years of experience in mortgage lending, ideally within a private banking or wealth management environment

• Solid understanding of mortgage underwriting, product structures, and risk mitigation techniques

• Familiarity with Swiss banking regulations and frameworks

• Ability to work independently, manage competing priorities, and deliver high-quality results

• A collaborative mindset with strong communication skills — proven ability to work effectively as a team player in cross-functional environments

• Fluency in German or English, coupled with demonstrable proficiency in French or Italian, is strongly preferred

jobs.description:
At Julius Baer, we celebrate and value the individual qualities you bring, enabling you to be impactful, to be entrepreneurial, to be empowered, and to create value beyond wealth. Let’s shape the future of wealth management together.

We are looking for a Business Analyst to help design, implement, and optimize Management Accounting processes as part of a large, strategic transformation initiative. • At least 2-5 years of professional experience in management accounting or internal reporting, ideally within the banking industry

• Reliable and flexible team player with a can-do attitude, strong analytical and problem-solving skills, and an enthusiasm for working in a dynamic environment
