jobs.title: Structured Products Sales, Zürich, 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
At Julius Baer, we celebrate and value the individual qualities you bring, enabling you to be impactful, to be entrepreneurial, to be empowered, and to create value beyond wealth. Let’s shape the future of wealth management together.

At Julius Baer, we empower our clients to achieve their most sophisticated financial aspirations through bespoke, insight-driven solutions. As a leading global wealth manager, we combine deep market expertise with an entrepreneurial spirit to deliver exceptional value, not only to our clients, but also to our people.

We are seeking a driven and knowledgeable Structured Products Sales, to join our Global Products & Solutions (GPS) unit, in Zürich.

In this pivotal role, you will act as a strategic partner to relationship managers and investment advisors, designing and promoting innovative, cross-asset structured solutions tailored to the unique objectives of ultra-high-net-worth clients.

More than just a product expert, you will be a trusted enabler of client conversations, providing actionable ideas, anticipating market trends, and actively contributing to the growth and evolution of our structured products offering. This is a collaborative, front-office position where technical excellence meets commercial impact.

You bring proven sales experience from a leading financial institution, possess strong analytical capabilities, and have a genuine passion for creating value through structured investments.

Fluent in German and deeply familiar with the Swiss private banking landscape, you are equally committed to strengthening internal partnerships as you are to driving results.

YOUR CHALLENGE

• Contribute to the growth of the book, with a focus on the Swiss German markets

• Provide expert advice to Relationship Managers and Investment Advisors on tailored investment solutions, with a focus on Structured Products, to meet client needs

• Identify emerging market trends and develop innovative investment strategies to expand our client offerings

• Design, price, and launch structured products based on equity, credit, and interest rate underlings

• Proactively manage product rollovers, notifying Relationship Managers and Investment Advisors of impending maturities and offering suitable replacement options

• Collaborate with internal stakeholders through regular desk meetings and advisory calls to promote Structured Products and drive business growth

• Deliver educational sessions to Relationship Managers to enhance their knowledge of Structured Products and improve sales effectiveness

• Contribute to the development of marketing materials that showcase investment ideas and opportunities

• Oversee day-to-day operations, including trade booking, post-sale support, and product lifecycle management

YOUR PROFILE

• Education: Bachelor's or master’s degree in Banking & Finance, Economics, Business Administration, or a related field

• Experience: Minimum 3-5 years of experience in an advisory or sales role, with P&l KPI

• Sales Drive: Results-driven mindset with a proven track-record in successfully developing clients / RM collaborations, and a strong desire to succeed in a sales-oriented environment

• Market Knowledge: Strong passion for financial markets, with a broad understanding of various asset classes and in-depth expertise in at least one area

• Structured Products Expertise: Advanced knowledge of Structured Products, including their design, pricing, and application

• Client Focus: Ability to analyse client situations, identify needs, and develop tailored solutions

• Communication Skills: Skilled in simplifying complex concepts and creating engaging advisory materials to support sales efforts

• Team Collaboration: Strong team player with excellent interpersonal skills, able to work effectively with colleagues and clients

• Technical Skills: Proficiency in programming languages such as Python and VBA, with the ability to apply technical skills to analyse and solve complex problems

• Language Proficiency: Fluency in German and English

jobs.title: Senior Security Engineer Logging SIEM Data Pipelines 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
At Julius Baer, we celebrate and value the individual qualities you bring, enabling you to be impactful, to be entrepreneurial, to be empowered, and to create value beyond wealth. Let’s shape the future of wealth management together.

We are seeking a senior security data engineer with deep expertise in SIEM platforms, telemetry pipelines, and security operations tooling to join our global team in Zurich. As the ideal candidate, you combine strong security foundations with a data engineering mindset and are comfortable architecting and operating high-volume, enterprise-scale logging and analytics infrastructure in a regulated financial services environment. You are proactive, technically curious, and thrive in both independent and collaborative work settings.
Your primary responsibilities will involve designing, operating, and evolving our centralised logging and SIEM platforms, building and maintaining data pipelines for intelligent log routing and enrichment, driving SOAR automation, and contributing to the expansion of our security data ecosystem — including early-stage observability use cases. You will work closely with security operations, infrastructure, and application teams to ensure reliable, high-quality data flows from source to insight.

YOUR CHALLENGE

• As part of a dedicated team, architect, operate, and continuously improve the Bank’s centralised logging and SIEM platforms, ensuring high availability, performance, and

• scalability for enterprise-grade data volumes

• Design, build, and maintain telemetry and data pipelines, enabling routing, enrichment, filtering, and multi-destination delivery of security and operational log data while maintaining

• cost-efficiency

• Drive the development and operationalisation of SOAR workflows to accelerate incident response, automate repetitive tasks, and improve security operations efficiency

• Develop and maintain service monitoring, detection content, reports, and dashboards that provide actionable security intelligence to stakeholders across the organisation

• Collaborate with security operations, IT infrastructure, and application teams to integrate new data sources, ensure data quality, and expand platform coverage — including early-stage

• contributions to observability use cases

• Maintain technical documentation including architecture descriptions, runbooks, data flow diagrams, and security parameterisations

• Coordinate the mitigation or resolution of security-relevant platform incidents with internal security stakeholders and external vendors

• Contribute to the development of architecture, standards, and best practices for the centralised logging and telemetry ecosystem

• Provide 2nd and 3rd level engineering support, including participation in an on-call rotation

YOUR PROFILE

• Highly proactive, solution-oriented, and results-driven with strong abstract and conceptual thinking skills

• Structured and goal-oriented approach to work, with the ability to independently assess, prioritise, and resolve complex tasks and requests

• Creative problem solver who challenges the status quo and proposes innovative solutions to existing issues

• Strong communicator who can translate technical complexity into clear guidance for platform users, stakeholders, and cross-functional teams

• Contribute to the development of architecture, concepts, and processes related to the Centralised Logging and Telemetry ecosystem

• Comfortable working across multiple application, infrastructure, and business teams

• Willingness and curiosity to learn new technologies and approaches in a rapidly evolving landscape

• University degree or higher technical education (university of applied sciences, federal diploma) in Computer Science, Information Security, or related discipline — or equivalent

• practical experience

• Minimum 5 years of hands-on experience engineering and administering enterprise SIEM platforms, with experience developing detection content, correlation searches, dashboards,

• and CIM-normalised data models

• Strong experience designing and operating data pipelines and log routing infrastructure, ideally with Cribl Stream or comparable telemetry pipeline tools

• Practical scripting and automation skills with one or more of: Python, Bash/Shell, JavaScript

• Working experience with GIT, SQL, REST APIs, and regular expressions

• Solid understanding of SOAR platforms and security operations automation

• Experience with configuration management tools such as Ansible is an advantage

• Fluent written and spoken English

• Good knowledge of German is a strong plus

jobs.title: Senior Test Manager - Finance Programme 100% (f/m/d) - (Contract through our external payroll partner with immediate start until 31.03.2028 with possible extension)
jobs.description:
At Julius Baer, we celebrate and value the individual qualities you bring, enabling you to be impactful, to be entrepreneurial, to be empowered, and to create value beyond wealth. Let’s shape the future of wealth management together.

YOUR CHALLENGE

• Leads end-to-end testing activities for a large Finance programme, including planning, scheduling, and execution of SIT, UAT, integration testing, and dress rehearsals, ensuring full alignment with the overarching change roadmap timelines and Finance-specific requirements

• Designs and develops comprehensive test cases, scripts, and acceptance criteria in collaboration with business SMEs and IT teams, ensuring full traceability to functional requirements and critical financial controls

• Manages test data and environment readiness, overseeing data anonymisation, provisioning, and environment validation across all stages (DEV to PROD), while ensuring compliance with data privacy standards and system interdependencies

• Coordinates defect management using tools like JIRA, tracks defect resolution, performs root cause analysis, and provides regular quality reporting - including defect trends, open risks, and test progress - to support informed Go/No-Go decisions

• Serves as the central point of contact during testing phase, supports UAT facilitation and sign-off, maintains cutover and rollback documentation, and provides hyper-care assistance to ensure a smooth transition and post-go-live stability

• Guiding business testers through the test process, including trainings in the use of Jira/xRay and creation of test cases

• Deputy of the Test Stream Lead

YOUR PROFILE

• Proven experience in software testing and quality assurance within large-scale IT or transformation projects, ideally in a financial services environment; strong familiarity with system implementation lifecycles (e.g., Agile, Waterfall) and testing best practices

• Extensive hands-on experience in managing end-to-end testing processes, including test planning, test case design, defect management, and execution of various testing types—SIT, UAT, regression, and end-to-end integration testing

• Solid understanding of financial systems and processes, particularly in areas such as Financial and Management Accounting, Treasury or Pricing, prior exposure to core banking platforms like Temenos T24 (Transact) or SAP is highly desirable

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with attention to detail in validating system behaviour against business requirements, identifying gaps, and ensuring traceability from requirements to test coverage and defect resolution

• Excellent coordination and communication abilities, with experience acting as a liaison between business users, IT teams, and project stakeholders; capable of preparing clear test reports, leading testing sessions, supporting UAT, and contributing to Go/No-Go decisions

• Strong Jira and xRay knowledge

• Seniority to represent Finance interest in large scale programmes

• Hands-on experience in delivering projects requirements pragmatically and managing complex dependencies

• Fluency in English is required, proficiency in German is an advantage

jobs.title: Senior IT Controller 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
At Julius Baer, we celebrate and value the individual qualities you bring, enabling you to be impactful, to be entrepreneurial, to be empowered, and to create value beyond wealth. Let’s shape the future of wealth management together.

We are looking for a highly motivated Senior IT Controller who is passionate about driving financial and operational governance, as well as project management office topics for the Group’s Technology area. You will join a dynamic and experienced team within the COO Chief of Staff unit, comprised of experts who act as sparring partners to the COO senior management, supporting them in achieving their objectives and vision around Run-the-Bank (RtB) and Change-the-Bank (CtB).

In this challenging and exciting role, you will be part of the IT Controlling & Management Support team and report to the Head of IT Controlling & Management Support.

YOUR CHALLENGE

• Take a lead role in Run-the-Bank (RtB) and Change-the-Bank (CtB) financial reporting, planning and closing activities

• Conduct and/or coordinate quantitative and qualitative analyses as a decision basis for RtB and CtB portfolio

• Lead and/or support strategic initiatives and projects, collaborating across teams and functions – such as Finance, Group IT, Transformation Office etc.

• Lead and/or support transformational activities related to front-to-back processes and governance topics

• Execute ad-hoc senior management level requests and analyses

• Prepare highly visible & storytelling-driven presentations to different bodies & stakeholders across the Group

YOUR PROFILE

• Strong academic record: University degree in Business Administration, Finance, Accounting, Econometrics or comparable field of study with above-average grades

• At least 5-7 years of experience in a comparable or related function within banking / background in consulting with a focus on technology / banking / finance sector

• Strong interest in Technology, Private Banking and Finance

• Outstanding analytical, conceptual and problem-solving skills with a strong affinity to quantitative modelling

• Excellent Excel & PowerPoint skills are a must. Programming skills (e.g. VBA / Python / SQL / R) as well as data visualization / business intelligence tools knowledge (e.g. Tableau) are a plus

• Strong personal drive with great organizational and multi-tasking skills as well as ability to work under pressure and in a fast-paced environment

• Strong communication and interpersonal skills to collaborate with multiple senior stakeholders and proven project management skills

• Fluent in German & English (spoken and written), any other language is a plus

jobs.description:
At Julius Baer, we celebrate and value the individual qualities you bring, enabling you to be impactful, to be entrepreneurial, to be empowered, and to create value beyond wealth. Let’s shape the future of wealth management together.

Join Julius Baer as an Application Operation, ensuring seamless operations of core banking systems through expert incident resolution, change coordination, and continuous process optimisation.

With a focus on stability and efficiency, you’ll play a key role in supporting critical applications, driving automation, and collaborating across IT and business teams in a dynamic financial environment.

YOUR CHALLENGE

• Ensure the smooth operation of core banking applications, focusing on application management (2nd-level support)

• Process incident tickets generated by monitoring systems and the local service desk within agreed SLAs

• Coordinate and communicate effectively between incident managers, application service owners, 3rd-level support, other IT/Agile teams, and business stakeholders

• Act as the local administrative Manager

• Take over periodical on-call duty (weekly 24/7 rotation)

• Administer change requests and ensure proper execution of application-related processes

• Participate in periodic release activities, including weekend deployments

• Contribute to projects related to operational aspects of existing or newly integrated applications

• Perform routine data cleansing and maintenance of systems

• Drive process optimization and automation of repetitive tasks, including handover to L1 (Control Center)

• Maintain and update application operation documentation and knowledge base

• Provide support for batch job scheduling and monitoring (e.g., Automic AWA, Control-M, or similar tools)

YOUR PROFILE

• Completed IT training (Degree in Computer Science or equivalent IT-related certification)

• Minimum of 2 years of professional experience in application support

• Strong Linux knowledge (shell scripting is an advantage)

• Solid understanding of Windows OS at server level

• Familiarity with Java application servers, databases, and workload automation tools (AWA experience is a plus)

• ITIL Foundation certification

• Experience in batch job support and scheduling tools (Automic AWA, Control-M, or similar)

• Ideally, experience in banking or financial services with knowledge of financial products

• Proven ability to manage small teams or demonstrated project management skills

• Highly motivated, proactive, and eager to learn new concepts

• Good written and spoken English

jobs.description:
At Julius Baer, we celebrate and value the individual qualities you bring, enabling you to be impactful, to be entrepreneurial, to be empowered, and to create value beyond wealth. Let’s shape the future of wealth management together.

We are seeking an experienced Business Analyst to spearhead the design, customization, and optimization of our core financial accounting processes. You will translate complex business requirements into scalable, compliant SAP solutions and ensure seamless integration with controlling (CO) and other core modules (MM, SD, FICO, RE-FX, AP, AR, ECCS) as well as several subledger own-developments.

• Support the implementation and optimization of SAP solutions

• Contribute to SAP S/4HANA transformation and related future initiatives

Responsibilities:

• Gather, analyze and document business and functional requirements

• Translate business needs into SAP finance solution designs and specifications

• Conduct process and gap analyses and recommend improvements

• Coordinate and support testing activities including defect resolution

• Collaborate with business stakeholders, SAP consultants and project teams throughout project lifecycles

Competencies:

• Ability to bridge business requirements and technical solutions

• Strong stakeholder management and proven communication skills with the ability to decompose complex solutions into compelling storylines

• Strong understanding of key business processes related to accounting, data flows, interfaces and related configuration within SAP

• Proactive, collaborative and result-oriented mindset

YOUR PROFILE

• Education: Degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, Information Technology or related fields

• Experience: Minimum 3 years of experience as a Business Analyst or SAP Finance Consultant. Experience in a banking environment is an advantage

• Platform: Good knowledge of SAP R/3 or SAP S/4HANA Finance processes. SAP Finance certification is considered an advantage

• Key Skills: Deep understanding of accounting principles, record-to-report (R2R) processes, and complex financial reporting

• Soft Skills: Fluent in English and/or German (written and spoken), strong communication skills, high motivation and drive to get things done, hands-on mentality and entrepreneurial spirit, high flexibility

jobs.title: Platform Owner 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
At Julius Baer, we celebrate and value the individual qualities you bring, enabling you to be impactful, to be entrepreneurial, to be empowered, and to create value beyond wealth. Let’s shape the future of wealth management together.

Julius Baer is looking for a forward-thinking Platform Owner to shape the future of Julius Baer`s enterprise technology platform offering. In this pivotal leadership role, you will define and drive the technical vision, roadmap, and operational excellence of the global data platform enabling data-driven decision-making and reporting across the bank.

You will play a central role in transforming how we build, scale, and govern our foundational data infrastructure - balancing innovation with robustness, agility with compliance, and speed with sustainability. Working closely with enterprise architecture, product owners, engineering teams, and external partners, you will ensure that platform capabilities consistently meet evolving business and consumer demands and adhere to stringent IT, risk, and regulatory standards.

YOUR CHALLENGE

• Define and maintain the end-to-end technical vision, multi-year roadmap, and lifecycle strategy for the global data platform

• Gathering requirements and maintaining relationships with current and potential consumer base. Ensuring the technical vision and roadmap enables their current and future business ambitions

• Ensure platform scalability, reliability, performance, and security, embedding non-functional requirements (NFRs), observability, automation, and resilience-by-design principles

• Lead the prioritisation and delivery of platform features and capabilities, collaborating with Product Manager, Scrum Masters, Development Teams, System Architect, and Release Train Engineer to coordinate work across Agile teams

• Own the platform backlog, ensuring clear initiatives, features, and user stories. Prioritise the delivery, balancing trade-offs between innovation, tech debt reduction, and operational stability

• Serve as the primary technical escalation point for incidents, problems, audits, and risk findings related to the platform

• Establish and monitor SLAs, SLOs, and KPIs; leverage metrics and OKRs to measure platform health, usage, team performance, and business value delivered

• Drive standardisation, reuse, and simplification across the platform ecosystem to reduce complexity, improve interoperability, and accelerate time-to-market

• Coach and guide Technical Leads, and development teams, fostering best practices in coding, testing, deployment, and incident response

• Shape the target operating model for platform operations—including staffing, governance, RACI definitions, and handover processes—supporting sustainable growth and efficient run-models

• Represent the platform in executive forums and governance bodies, articulating progress, risks, investments, and strategic decisions to stakeholders across technology and business areas

YOUR PROFILE

• Bachelor's or master’s degree in computer science, Information Systems, or a related field

• Minimum of 10 years of experience in technology roles within large, regulated enterprises—preferably in financial services

• Proven experience owning, leading or scaling large-scale data platforms – preferably big data technology

• Track record with defining and delivering technical platform visions and roadmaps in enterprise environments

• Hands-on exposure to modern data technologies such as Apache Spark / Iceberg, Trino, Kafka, Kubernetes, Snowflake/Databricks, Hadoop ecosystems, or equivalent

• Strong understanding of Agile methodologies, DevOps practices, CI/CD pipelines

• Track record in managing cross-functional initiatives involving multiple technical teams, vendors, and domains—demonstrating influence without direct authority

• Familiarity with risk and compliance frameworks applicable to Swiss financial institutions and experience addressing audit points or IT risk items

• Exceptional technical leadership and systems thinking, able to balance short-term delivery with long-term platform sustainability

• Strong communication skills on all levels. Ability to summarise complex issues for management, while also being able to discuss on a detail level with technical teams

• Expertise in software lifecycle governance, technical debt management, vulnerability remediation, and release approval processes

• Skilled in road-mapping, backlog refinement, dependency management, and translating business capabilities into actionable technical initiatives

• People person or comfortable with significant business / consumer interaction

• Solid understanding of non-functional requirements—performance, availability, recoverability, monitoring, logging, and security-by-default

• Strong analytical mindset with the ability to make data-informed decisions using KPIs, telemetry, and feedback loops

• Fluent in English, both written and verbal; German language skills are a advantage

• Ability to operate effectively in a matrixed, multinational environment with competing priorities

jobs.title: Team Lead Web Entry Solutions 80 - 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
At Julius Baer, we celebrate and value the individual qualities you bring, enabling you to be impactful, to be entrepreneurial, to be empowered, and to create value beyond wealth. Let’s shape the future of wealth management together.

As Team Lead Web Entry Solutions, you assume strategic and operational responsibility for the operation and continuous advancement of our central web entry security infrastructures. You lead a globally distributed, highly specialised team at our locations in Switzerland and Singapore, and play a key role in making the security architecture of a leading global financial institution fit for the future.
Working in close collaboration with IT Service Owners, architects and engineering teams, you drive the delivery of demanding security projects and provide expert guidance to business units on complex security topics. You combine deep technical expertise with strong leadership skills and a strategic view of the overall IT security posture.

YOUR CHALLENGE
Operations & Web Application Security Architecture

• Own the stable operation and strategic development of core IT security infrastructures in the Web Entry domain

• Design, implement and continuously optimise Web Application Firewall and API security architectures based on the Nevis Identity Suite – including rule sets, filter policies and WAF configurations

• Operate, configure and advance security functions such as ModSecurity and Core Rule Sets (CRS)

• Design, implement and operate Global Single Sign-On (GSSO) solutions based on SAML 2.0 and OpenID Connect (OIDC)

• Ensure comprehensive protection against all OWASP Top 10 vulnerability categories (Injection, Broken Access Control, XSS, SSRF, etc.) at both infrastructure and application level

• Operate and evolve load-balancing solutions and multi-layered DDoS protection mechanisms (rate limiting, IP reputation management, bot management)

• Monitor and analyse HTTP/S traffic for anomalies, attack patterns and policy violations using centralised logging and SIEM platforms

Security Governance, Assessments & Projects

• Own security assessments, vulnerability management and baseline compliance across the Web Entry platforms

• Evaluate and prioritise findings from penetration tests, DAST scans and bug bounty programmes; coordinate remediation with development and operations teams

• Drive and deliver complex security projects with a strategic view of the overall IT security posture

• Analyse and manage security incidents (web attacks, WAF bypasses, credential stuffing, bot traffic) and coordinate incident response

• Create and maintain security concepts, WAF policies, technical documentation and operating procedures

• Continuously optimise WAF rule sets, proxy configurations and security baselines; identify and implement improvement opportunities

Leadership & Advisory

• Provide disciplinary and functional leadership to a globally distributed team in Switzerland and Singapore

• Advise and support business units on security topics; actively accompany new security initiatives from concept through to production deployment

• Collaborate closely with IT Service Owners, architects, engineering teams and external partners in a regulated enterprise environment

YOUR PROFILE

• University degree (BSc / MSc / ETH) or higher technical qualification (HF/FH) in Computer Science, Information Security or a comparable technical discipline

• In-depth, demonstrated knowledge of the OWASP Top 10 – mandatory: hands-on experience in identifying, assessing and mitigating all current vulnerability categories

• Strong hands-on expertise in configuring, operating and tuning ModSecurity including the OWASP CRS – experience with false-positive management and custom rule development is mandatory

• Solid understanding of web application architectures: HTTP/S protocol, REST APIs, reverse-proxy concepts, TLS/mTLS, Content Security Policy (CSP), CORS, HTTP security headers (HSTS, X-Frame-Options, etc.)

• Demonstrated practical experience with the Nevis Identity Suite or comparable enterprise WAF / reverse-proxy solutions (e.g. F5 ASM, Barracuda WAF, AWS WAF, Azure Application Gateway WAF)

• Knowledge of security-focused API protection: API gateways, OAuth 2.0 token validation, rate limiting, input validation

• Experience handling penetration-testing findings and security-focused code reviews in a web application context

• Sound, proven expertise in network and application security – this role is not suitable for career starters

• Solid knowledge of modern authentication and authorisation protocols (SAML 2.0, OpenID Connect, OAuth 2.0, PKCE)

• Proficient in Azure security concepts: Azure Policy, Identity Governance in Microsoft Entra ID, AKS Security Posture Management, Microsoft Defender for Cloud

• Demonstrated experience in hybrid environments (cloud and on-premises) and in the secure operation of containerised workloads (Kubernetes, Docker)

• Proven track record in disciplinary and functional management of internationally distributed teams, ideally in a complex, global environment

• Strong communication and stakeholder management skills at all organisational levels

• Fluent English – written and spoken (working language)

Nice to have:

• Experience in the financial sector, in regulated environments or audit-intensive contexts (e.g. FINMA, MAS, DORA)

• Recognised security certifications: CISM, CISSP, CCSP, AZ-500, SC-100 or GWAPT (GIAC Web Application Penetration Tester)

• Knowledge of Secure Software Development Lifecycle (SSDLC) and DevSecOps practices, e.g. SAST/DAST integration in CI/CD pipelines

• Familiarity with the OWASP Application Security Verification Standard (ASVS) as an assessment framework for web applications

• Experience with threat modelling (e.g. STRIDE) and structured risk analysis of web architectures

• Understanding of cloud-native DevOps practices or cloud platform operating models (e.g. AKS, Azure Landing Zones, Infrastructure as Code)

• German language skills

jobs.description:
At Julius Baer, we celebrate and value the individual qualities you bring, enabling you to be impactful, to be entrepreneurial, to be empowered, and to create value beyond wealth. Let’s shape the future of wealth management together.

We are looking for a technically strong Execution Management Support Specialist to support our buy side trading desks. The role focuses on ensuring smooth order routing, execution workflow stability, and rapid issue resolution across multiple electronic trading platforms.

YOUR CHALLENGE

• Provide real‑time support for order routing, execution issues, and trade flow across equity, fixed income, structured products, crypto and multi‑asset desks

• Support basic scripting or programming tasks to automate routing, implement checks and analyse logs

YOUR PROFILE

• Financial engineering or programming (nice to have)

• Experience in trading support or electronic execution workflows

• Strong understanding of FIX protocol and order routing mechanics

• Solid understanding of Temenos T24 is a big plus (architecture and business workflows)

• Basic programming or scripting skills (e.g., Python, SQL, Java, Bash)

• Familiarity with electronic trading platforms: TradeSmart, MarketAxess, TSOX, Bloomberg EMSX/TOMS, TradeWeb

• Good understanding of market microstructure and electronic execution workflows

• Detail-oriented, fast-thinking, and comfortable supporting traders in time-critical environments

• FIX certification and CFA or similar would be a nice-to-have

• Fluent in English (verbal and written); German would be a nice-to-have

jobs.title: Compliance Officer – Monitoring & Control Execution 80-100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
At Julius Baer, we celebrate and value the individual qualities you bring, enabling you to be impactful, to be entrepreneurial, to be empowered, and to create value beyond wealth. Let’s shape the future of wealth management together.

We are seeking a highly organized and proactive Compliance Officer to strengthen our Central Compliance team in Zurich. In this role, you will take ownership of executing and enhancing second-line-of-defense (2LoD) monitoring controls—ensuring robust oversight across critical risk areas including Client Suitability, Pricing, and Intermediary Framework. This position offers a unique opportunity to shape the evolution of our compliance control framework while serving as a trusted partner to front-line functions and senior stakeholders.

YOUR CHALLENGE

• Design & Assessment: Develop, evaluate, and refine effective 2LoD controls tailored to key compliance risks, ensuring alignment with regulatory expectations and business operations

• Control Execution: Perform timely and accurate execution of recurring compliance controls, with a primary focus on client suitability assessments, as well as secondary coverage of pricing practices, intermediary framework, and other defined risk areas

• Deficiency Management: Partner closely with Client-Facing Units to address control weaknesses via structured remediation workflows (leveraging CLM Task Manager), providing guidance and tracking resolution to closure

• Reporting & Validation: Conduct thorough analysis and validation of control outputs and exception reports

• Stakeholder Collaboration: Participate in regular coordination meetings with Business Relationship Managers (BRMs) to discuss findings, escalate issues, and drive accountability

• Audit & Regulatory Support: Act as the central point of contact during internal audits and external supervisory reviews, representing control design and performance outcomes

• Continuous Improvement: Translate operational insights into concrete recommendations for improving compliance processes, digital tools, and policy standards

• Policy & Training Contribution: Contribute to the development and update of compliance policies and play an active role in designing targeted training modules for frontline staff

YOUR PROFILE

• Completed banking apprenticeship or university degree in Banking & Finance, Business Administration, or a related field

• Minimum of 3 years’ experience in Private Banking, ideally within Compliance, Risk Management, or a control function

• Solid understanding of client suitability rules and processes (e.g., MiFID II principles, internal CRM protocols)

• Familiarity with core private banking activities and associated conduct & operational risks

• Strong analytical capabilities with proficiency in root cause analysis and issue resolution

• Advanced user of MS Office Suite, particularly Excel (pivot tables, lookups) and PowerPoint (executive presentations)

• A collaborative team player with initiative, emotional intelligence, and strong stakeholder engagement skills

• Proven communication and interpersonal skills to deal with employees and stakeholders on different management levels

• Detail-oriented with excellent organizational abilities; capable of managing multiple deadlines in a dynamic environment

• High personal integrity, discretion, and adherence to ethical standards

• Resilient and solution-focused, thriving under pressure while maintaining precision

• Fluency in English (written and spoken); other languages are an advantage

We are seeking a detail-oriented and reliable professional with a banking or commercial background to handle corporate actions, tax refunds, securities transactions, and payment processing. The ideal candidate has strong German and English skills, works independently and collaboratively, and takes initiative in a dynamic operational environment.

YOUR CHALLENGE

• Ensuring the timely and correct processing of interest and dividend events

• Supervision of tax refund processes in various markets

• Reconciliation and correction of security and cash differences

• Identification and processing of securities lending and borrowing positions and correspondence with counterparties

• Processing of internal and external payments

• Timely and competent management of the service mailbox and hotline

YOUR PROFILE

• High degree of self-interest and sense of responsibility

• Ability to work in a team, collegiality and reliability

• Independence, accuracy, resilience and flexibility

• Very good verbal and written skills in German and English

• Enjoyment of professional and technical details

• Banking apprenticeship, basic commercial training or high school diploma (preferably with banking experience)

• Knowledge of securities (experience with administrative transactions an advantage)

We are looking forward to receiving your full job application through our online application tool. Further interesting job opportunities can be found on our Career site.

jobs.title: Data Management Specialist 100% (f/m/d) - Maternity Cover until 31 March 2027
jobs.description:
At Julius Baer, we celebrate and value the individual qualities you bring, enabling you to be impactful, to be entrepreneurial, to be empowered, and to create value beyond wealth. Let’s shape the future of wealth management together.

How would you use data to create the bank of the future?

As Data Management Specialist, you build the foundation for the strategic transformation at Julius Baer, driving data-centricity. You will join the team for a fixed period of time to cover a maternity leave.

You are at the heart of the bank’s transformation and bring together colleagues from all units, be it Front, IT or Compliance to achieve excellence.

Are you up for the challenge? This is your opportunity to be a driver for change and take your career to the next level.

YOUR CHALLENGE

• Take-up the challenge to drive the topic during the maternity period until end of March 27

• Co-design and monitor data management standards and processes

• Co-design and monitor bank-wide data product standards and processes

• Work closely with representatives from the front office business units and supporting business functions like legal, compliance, finance, operations Enterprise Architecture and IT

• Enable and co-create with business data models according to company, industry and architectural standards

YOUR PROFILE

• Earned a university degree or equivalent, preferably in science, business informatics, banking or finance

• Several years of experience in metadata management, data dictionary, information architecture, data lineage, reference data and business glossary

• Experience in the financial industry, banking industry

• Acquainted working with data modeling and data management tools in general (data dictionary, data lineage, etc.)

• Can do attitude

• Strong at collaborating and influencing, building an effective stakeholder network across divisions and regions

• Comfortable in challenging the status quo and manage escalations on every level

• Great teammate, who is fun to work with and drives the change naturally

• Fluent in English, German would be an advantage

jobs.title: Legal Counsel Procurement 80-100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
At Julius Baer, we celebrate and value the individual qualities you bring, enabling you to be impactful, to be entrepreneurial, to be empowered, and to create value beyond wealth. Let’s shape the future of wealth management together.

Julius Baer seeks a motivated and experienced legal counsel within the team Legal Digital & Contracts with a focus on advising on and negotiating procurement contracts and a wide range of other type of contractual engagements. The role further entails legal support and participation in projects related to technology, operational innovation, and digitization.
In this role, you will be the key legal advisor to the Procurement function and other business areas in relation to negotiating contracts and will collaborate with various different professionals from Legal and Data Protection, Information Security and IT based in Switzerland and other locations in Europe, Middle East and Asia.

YOUR CHALLENGE
You will be responsible for the full range of legal tasks concerning commercial contracts of Julius Baer with suppliers and providers, which includes:

• being part of negotiations of a range of commercial contracts and agreements across all business functions of Julius Baer, in particular agreements regarding SaaS, EULAs, Master Services Agreements (MSA), Work Orders / Statements of Work for onshore as well as offshore delivery

• provide ongoing legal support and legal risk assessments to the Procurement function throughout the contract lifecycle

• maintain and further develop standard agreements such as MSA and the General Purchasing Conditions to provide a stable and sound contractual basis to the business when purchasing goods and services

• ensure compliance with regulatory requirements and company policies in contracts with suppliers and providers

• Provide legal advice and support related to digitization and legal tech aspects

• preparing and conducting trainings on legal topics relevant to the Procurement function

YOUR PROFILE
To be successful, you should have the following skills:

• Master of Laws degree; bar admission, LL.M., and/or additional job-relevant certifications are an advantage

• at least 5 years of professional experience as a lawyer in a law firm or in-house, with demonstrated expertise in drafting, reviewing, and negotiating commercial contracts in an international context, preferably in the financial industry

• profound and practical knowledge of Swiss contract law and related regulations, in particular with respect to outsourcing as well as operational risks and resilience

• you are passionate about technology, innovation, and digitalisation topics and willing to constantly expand your knowledge in the relevant fields of expertise

• excellent interpersonal skills and ability to efficiently communicate with stakeholders with a broad variety of backgrounds (such as Procurement, IT / IT Sourcing, Information Security, HR, Business and Legal)

• you are a positive self-starter with a can-do attitude who proactively approaches challenges in an analytical way and comes up with structured and tailored solutions

• excellent command of German and English (written and spoken)

We are looking forward to receiving your full job application through our online application tool. Further interesting job opportunities can be found on our Career site.

jobs.title: Senior Business Analyst – Financial Systems & Data Transformation 100% (f/m/d) - (Contract through our external payroll partner with possible extension until 30.04.2028)
jobs.description:
At Julius Baer, we celebrate and value the individual qualities you bring, enabling you to be impactful, to be entrepreneurial, to be empowered, and to create value beyond wealth. Let’s shape the future of wealth management together.

The Senior Business Analyst plays a key role in driving efficiency and innovation across financial operations at Julius Baer. This position bridges business needs and technology solutions through rigorous analysis, collaboration, and solution delivery. Ensuring that system enhancements and new initiatives align with business goals, regulatory standards, and enterprise architecture principles.

YOUR CHALLENGE

• Business Requirements Gathering: Elicit, analyse, document, and validate business requirements from stakeholders, including process owners, end-users, and senior management

• Financial Systems Analysis: Analyse existing financial systems, processes, and data to identify areas for improvement, optimise workflows, and ensure compliance with regulatory requirements

• Data Modelling: Data modelling principles and practices, including conceptual, logical, and physical data model design

• Solution Development: Collaborate with IT teams to design, implement, and test solutions, ensuring alignment with business objectives and stakeholder expectations

• Process Improvement: Identify opportunities to streamline financial processes, eliminate inefficiencies, and improve overall productivity

• Stakeholder Management: Communicate effectively with stakeholders at all levels, including technical and non-technical audiences, to ensure understanding and buy-in of proposed solutions

• Data Analysis: Collect, analyse, and interpret large datasets to inform business decisions, identify trends, and measure performance metrics

• Documentation and Reporting: Develop and maintain accurate documentation, including business cases, use cases, user stories, and reports, to support project delivery and ongoing operations

• Testing and Quality Assurance: Participate in testing and quality assurance activities to ensure solutions meet business requirements and are free from defects

• Change Management: Support organisational change by communicating changes to stakeholders, providing training and guidance as needed

YOUR PROFILE

• Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Finance, Accounting, Computer Science, or a related field

• Proven track record as a Senior Business Analyst within the banking or financial services industry, preferably in investment banking, asset management, or wealth management

• Strong understanding of financial concepts, instruments, and markets

• Experience with financial systems such as SAP S/4HANA and BW/4HANA, trading platforms, risk engines, or core banking applications

• Practical knowledge of enterprise data architecture and the ability to translate business needs into scalable, secure, and compliant data structures

• Prior experience in large-scale transformation programmes is highly advantageous

• Proficiency in Microsoft Office suite (Excel, Word, PowerPoint); advanced PowerPoint skills for storytelling and visualisation are highly valued

• Experience with Agile methodologies (Jira/Confluence experience) and iterative development approaches

• Solid grasp of SDLC and project management methodologies, with hands-on involvement in testing, UAT, and system go-live activities

• A self-driven and proactive personality, with the ability to take ownership, anticipate needs, and drive initiatives forward with minimal supervision

• Comfortable operating in a high-pressure, dynamic environment, managing competing priorities with resilience and a solutions-oriented mindset

• Fluent in English; German language skills are a strong advantage

We only consider candidates who can start immediately.

We are looking forward to receiving your full job application through our online application tool. Further interesting job opportunities can be found on our Career site.

jobs.title: Senior SAP Project Manager – Finance Transformation 80-100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
At Julius Baer, we celebrate and value the individual qualities you bring, enabling you to be impactful, to be entrepreneurial, to be empowered, and to create value beyond wealth. Let’s shape the future of wealth management together.

The Senior SAP Project Manager is a key role within Julius Baer, located in the CFO Global Accounting, Reporting and Finance Operations department.

In this role, you will lead and deliver strategic SAP Finance projects, working closely with Finance, Business, and IT stakeholders. The position is pivotal in driving the successful implementation and evolution of SAP solutions, shaping the future Finance landscape with a strong focus on SAP S/4HANA and SAP Group Reporting.

YOUR CHALLENGE
As Senior SAP Project Manager, you will:

• Lead and deliver complex SAP Finance projects end-to-end, with focus on:

• SAP Group Reporting

• SAP S/4HANA Finance (Financial Accounting and Management Accounting)

• Enhancement and continuous evolution of the existing SAP ERP landscape

• Ensure successful project delivery in line with agreed scope, timeline, budget, and quality targets

• Be responsible for business analysis and project management and providing respective information including data flows, business requirements and test cases

• Establish and manage strong project governance, including:

• Detailed planning and milestone tracking

• Dependency and integration management

• Risk and issue management

• Preparation of decision documents with impact analysis and solution options

• Act as the main interface between Finance and IT to ensure successful implementation of SAP solutions

• Translate business requirements into SAP solutions in close collaboration with functional and technical teams

• Drive collaboration with IT and Architecture to ensure solutions are aligned with enterprise standards and CFO’s long-term strategy

• Be responsible for a qualitative and timely technical implementation, testing and sign-off

• Support business stakeholders during the transformation journey, ensuring adoption and value realization

• Identify improvement opportunities and contribute to the continuous evolution of Finance SAP systems and processes

YOUR PROFILE
The successful candidate is a seasoned SAP Project Manager with a strong track record in delivering complex SAP Finance projects in the financial services industry.

Professional Experience

• Proven experience as an SAP Project Manager delivering large-scale implementations, ideally including:

• SAP S/4HANA Finance

• Strong expertise in SAP Finance modules and related solutions (e.g., FI/CO, AA, consolidation, reporting, planning, analytics)

• Solid understanding of finance processes, including:

• Consolidation

• Controlling

• Financial Accounting

• External reporting

• Data and reporting architecture

• Experience delivering projects using both waterfall and agile methodologies

• Experience as business analyst in SAP transformation projects

• Experience in the Finance department (Financial Accounting, Management Accounting, Consolidation) of a bank within an international environment is an advantage

• Experience in financial services, ideally private banking

Skills & Competencies

• Strong delivery and execution mindset with hands-on project leadership experience

• Excellent stakeholder management skills across business and IT

• Ability to manage complex, cross-functional environments and multiple workstreams

• Pragmatic, solution-oriented, and structured working style

• Strong communication and influencing skills at all organizational levels

• Ability to manage ambiguity and drive results

Education & Languages

• University degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Finance, or a related field

• Fluent in English; German is a strong advantage

What Sets You Apart

• Hands-on experience delivering SAP Group Reporting or consolidation projects

• Deep understanding of SAP Finance architecture and data structures

• Strong track record of delivering SAP projects on time and within budget

• Strong drive to deliver tangible business value through SAP-enabled Finance transformation

jobs.title: PRODUCT OWNER – INVESTMENT CONTENT PRODUCTION & DISTRIBUTION 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
At Julius Baer, we celebrate and value the individual qualities you bring, enabling you to be impactful, to be entrepreneurial, to be empowered, and to create value beyond wealth. Let’s shape the future of wealth management together.

At Julius Baer, we celebrate and value the individual qualities you bring — empowering you to be impactful, entrepreneurial, and driven to create value beyond wealth. Together, we’re shaping the future of global wealth management through innovation, client focus, and responsible growth.

We are seeking a Product Owner to play a key role in advancing our digital transformation journey. As part of the Investment Content Production & Distribution team, you will lead forward-thinking digital initiatives with a deeply client-obsessed mindset, bridging business priorities and technology delivery.

In this role, you will take ownership within the digital platform for Julius Baer’s investment products and offerings, ensuring accurate, timely, and consistent representation across client and advisor touchpoints. You will define the product vision, prioritise the backlog, and collaborate closely with technology teams to deliver reliable, user-centric solutions within an agile environment.

Your work will directly influence how investment product data — including availability, classification, and structuring rules — is managed and activated across our advisory and wealth management ecosystems.
Balancing business strategy, regulatory requirements, and user experience, you’ll drive improvements in automation, integration, and lifecycle management to ensure reliability and scalability across markets.

YOUR CHALLENGE

• Partner with Business, Technology, and Product Specialist teams to maintain and refine product

• onboarding processes and classification standards

• Work closely with Legal and Compliance to assess the regulatory impact of digital solutions

• Translate client needs into product vision; lead stakeholder engagement, prioritisation, and maintenance of a well-groomed backlog aligned with epics and features

• Take full ownership of assigned products throughout their lifecycle, ensuring regulatory compliance and optimal performance

• Collaborate with Agile Release Trains (ARTs) to deliver functionality, manage cross-ART dependencies, and guide trade-off decisions

• Act as a trusted advisor to business and senior stakeholders by presenting design and implementation strategies, integrating continuous user feedback

• Support Change Management through training planning and development of accessible client and frontline engagement materials

• Strengthen product ownership practices via structured backlogs, clear accountabilities, and regular refinement

• Leverage behavioural analytics and usability testing to iteratively enhance client experiences

• Establish adoption frameworks and feedback loops to ensure products meet evolving client needs

• Uphold the Bank’s values and conduct, demonstrating integrity, due diligence, fairness to clients, effective conflict-of-interest management, competence, and strict adherence to all applicable rules and risk protocols ​

YOUR PROFILE

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in a relevant field such as Computer Science, Finance, Business Administration, or Engineering

• Proven experience (2–5 years) as a Product Owner or in a comparable role within financial services, fintech, technology, or consulting—preferably in client-facing banking or wealth management environments

• Partner with business stakeholders, technology teams, product specialists, and legal colleagues to maintain and continuously improve product onboarding processes and classification standards

• Translate client needs into actionable product visions; lead stakeholder engagement, prioritisation, and the maintenance of a well-groomed backlog aligned with epics and features

• Take end-to-end ownership of assigned products deliverables across their lifecycle, ensuring regulatory compliance, functional integrity, and high performance

• Collaborate closely with Agile Release Trains (ARTs) to deliver value-driven functionality, manage cross-ART dependencies, and support effective front change management

• Solid understanding of investment products, including relevant regulations and comprehensive lifecycle management

• Familiarity with key regulatory frameworks such as MiFID II and FIDLEG

At Julius Baer, we celebrate and value the individual qualities you bring — empowering you to be impactful, entrepreneurial, and driven to create value beyond wealth. Together, we’re shaping the future of global wealth management through innovation, client focus, and responsible growth.

We are seeking a Product Owner to play a key role in advancing our digital transformation journey. As part of the Investment Content Production & Distribution team, you will lead forward-thinking digital initiatives with a deeply client-obsessed mindset, bridging business priorities and technology delivery.

In this role, you will take ownership within the digital platform for Julius Baer’s investment products and offerings, ensuring accurate, timely, and consistent representation across client and advisor touchpoints. You will define the product vision, prioritise the backlog, and collaborate closely with technology teams to deliver reliable, user-centric solutions within an agile environment.

Your work will directly influence how investment product data — including availability, classification, and structuring rules — is managed and activated across our advisory and wealth management ecosystems.

• onboarding processes and classification standards

jobs.title: Third-Party Risk Manager – CRO Non-Financial Risk 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
At Julius Baer, we celebrate and value the individual qualities you bring, enabling you to be impactful, to be entrepreneurial, to be empowered, and to create value beyond wealth. Let’s shape the future of wealth management together.

We are seeking a risk professional to support our Third-Party Risk Management unit. The Third Party Risk Management unit as second line of defence function maintains and develops the Third-Party Risk Management (TPRM) framework, ensuring compliance with regulatory requirements and alignment with the Risk Management Framework. This position reports to the Head of TPRM, who  is the Global Policy Owner (GPO) of third party risk-related policies as well as the Risk Type Owner (RTO) of the risk type “Third Party Management Risk (incl. intragroup services)”.

YOUR CHALLENGE

• Support the end-to-end implementation and global rollout of the Group’s third-party risk management framework in line with the defined roadmap

• Define business use cases and functional requirements for IT implementations and AI-enabled solutions; design and execute test procedures for infrastructure upgrades and system migrations

• Assist the RTO in portfolio risk assessments, operational case reviews, control monitoring, and international regulatory reporting; drive timely follow-up on action items, incidents, and escalation flags

• Compile, validate, and prepare quantitative and qualitative reporting packages for committees and key stakeholders

• Maintain and update central documentation (Wiki pages, procedures, templates, intranet), develop training materials, and deliver training sessions to ensure consistent adoption across locations

• Coordinate stakeholder meetings, track progress on framework implementation, and conduct quality checks on resolution strategies and exit plans globally

YOUR PROFILE

• University degree or equivalent (preferably in economics / law)

• Broad and practical experience in non-financial risk management, with a minimum of 3-5 years within management consulting or accounting / law firm

• Sound knowledge of outsourcing/third party risk regulations and industry best practices

• Familiarity with ServiceNow for process automation, ticketing, and IT service management workflows.

• Able to formulate clear business requirements for IT implementations and AI use cases within  the TPRM related applications, ensuring alignment with business objectives and regulatory requirements .

• Strong “hands on” analytical and project delivery capabilities, with the ability to turn concepts into practical, implementable solutions

• Excellent PowerPoint and presentation skills

• Proven ability to rapidly learn new concepts and ideas, and integrate and assimilate information of various levels of complexity and relationships across broad, multifunctional content areas

• Self-motivated, team-oriented and hands-on personality

• Strong communication, presentation and interpersonal skills

• Able to work under pressure and react positively in the face of change

• Fluency in German and English, any further language is an advantage

jobs.title: Senior System Architect - Client Lifecycle Management (CLM) 100% (f/m/d) - (Contract through our external payroll partner for 12 months with possible extension)
jobs.description:
At Julius Baer, we celebrate and value the individual qualities you bring, enabling you to be impactful, to be entrepreneurial, to be empowered, and to create value beyond wealth. Let’s shape the future of wealth management together.

As a System Architect within the Global IT Architecture team, you play a central role in defining and delivering Solution Architectures for the Client Lifecycle Management (CLM) programme - a strategic initiative to harmonise the bank’s end-to-end client lifecycle processes.

Working alongside Domain and Foundation Architects, you bridge architecture and engineering, ensuring solutions align with target architecture and comply with enterprise standards.

YOUR CHALLENGE

• Design and own Solution Architectures for applications in delivery, ensuring adherence to domain-level targets and architectural principles

• Ensure architectural alignment across the software lifecycle, from concept through testing, release, and operational phases

• Identify, document, and manage architecture debt arising from deviations between transitional implementations and long-term goals

• Initiate and formalise key decisions through Architecture Decision Records (ADRs), securing approval from relevant architecture boards

• Advise and mentor software engineers and Tech Leads on technical implementation, ensuring feasibility, scalability, and compliance

• Collaborate with Product Owners to refine business initiatives, translating requirements into actionable capabilities and building blocks

• Actively contribute to the global Domain Architecture Board: present blueprints, review peer designs, and help shape the overall target architecture

• Enforce architecture governance across development teams and uphold quality standards throughout delivery

YOUR PROFILE

• 3+ years as a Senior Architect and 5+ years in lead/senior software engineering roles with prior exposure to highly regulated sectors, ideally banking or financial services

• Full-lifecycle ownership of solution architectures - from design and implementation to operations

• Demonstrated ability to evaluate architectural alternatives and make sound trade-offs under constraints

• Skilled in analysing complex business needs and transforming them into robust, scalable technical solutions

• Strong command of modern architecture styles: microservices, event-driven systems, modular monoliths

• Familiarity with integration patterns, Kafka, data streaming, Kubernetes, and hybrid cloud/on-premise environments

• Proficient in UML and ArchiMate modelling, with hands-on experience using EA tools such as Sparx Enterprise Architect

• Good understanding of BPMN 2.0 and business process modelling

• Deep knowledge of DevOps practices and software engineering excellence

• Certification advantage (e.g., SAFe); proven experience applying architecture within agile/SAFe delivery frameworks

• Excellent communication, presentation, and stakeholder coordination skills

• Fluent in English, with good knowledge in German

jobs.description:
At Julius Baer, we celebrate and value the individual qualities you bring, enabling you to be impactful, to be entrepreneurial, to be empowered, and to create value beyond wealth. Let’s shape the future of wealth management together.

Responsible for overseeing the end-to-end operation of an IT service in accordance with predefined service level agreements. This encompasses the thorough understanding and meticulous tracking of all service dependencies and proactive lifecycle management.

YOUR CHALLENGE
In the beginning the following two topics will be in focus:

• The Central Identity Data Platform for JB. It provides user and persona entries along with master data. Clients connect through JID's RESTful and streaming interfaces to read the respective access data.

• BJB central UID web Service. The UIDservice is the source for user id’s in JB. It will calculate user id’s for different types of users such as employees, non-personal users, BOI users and others

Additionally, the following activities apply:

• Application management (Maintenance and Support, SLA, Incident-, Problem-, Release/Test-, Risk-Mgmt, Lifecycle, Documentation) within the area of "Identity and Access Management"

jobs.title: Senior Java Engineer – HPC Cluster Development & Maintenance, 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
At Julius Baer, we celebrate and value the individual qualities you bring, enabling you to be impactful, to be entrepreneurial, to be empowered, and to create value beyond wealth. Let’s shape the future of wealth management together.

We are seeking a strong Java engineer to develop and maintain a High-Performance Computing (HPC) cluster comprising hundreds of servers (on-premises and augmented by Microsoft Azure). This cluster provides critical computing power to a modern trading floor.

The cluster scheduling and control systems are primarily built in Java, with Apache Ignite as the clustering layer. Jobs are received from internal clients via legacy HTTP and ActiveMQ interfaces, while modern clients use an in-house API developed in Java and Python. System statistics are collected in MongoDB and Elastic/Kibana.

This role requires ensuring high availability for a mission-critical resource, developing a deep understanding of a large existing codebase, and proposing improvements. You will also maintain and enhance multiple monitoring systems for both infrastructure and client job submissions.

YOUR CHALLENGE

• Develop and maintain Java-based cluster scheduling and control systems.

• Ensure high availability and reliability of HPC resources.

• Maintain and improve monitoring systems for infrastructure and client submissions.

• Collaborate with internal stakeholders to balance resource allocation with business requirements.

• Troubleshoot and optimize performance across on-prem and Azure-augmented environments.

• Ensure compliance with banking regulatory requirements.

YOUR PROFILE

• Strong Java multithreaded development expertise (core and enterprise-level)

Experience with:

• Distributed Execution Engines.

• NoSQL Databases

• ActiveMQ (messaging)

• Front-end Web Technologies (legacy UI maintenance)

• Python (for API and tooling)

Familiarity with:

• Azure Portal and Azure SDK for Java

• Red Hat Linux

• Understanding of banking systems and regulatory requirements

• Language: Fluent English; German is a plus

Bonus Skills:

• Scala and C++

• Kubernetes (container orchestration)

What We Offer:

• Opportunity to work on mission-critical systems in a high-performance environment

• Exposure to cutting-edge HPC and cloud technologies

• Collaborative team culture in a dynamic trading environment

jobs.description:
At Julius Baer, we celebrate and value the individual qualities you bring, enabling you to be impactful, to be entrepreneurial, to be empowered, and to create value beyond wealth. Let’s shape the future of wealth management together.

We are seeking an experienced IT Project Manager to manage the implementation and adjust “Liquidity Risk Management Asia” to enhance internal liquidity controls and tools to fulfil regulations.

YOUR CHALLENGE

• Ensure comprehensive requirement gathering, analysis, and documentation in close partnership with business stakeholders in Risk, Treasury, Compliance, and regional entities

• Take full ownership of end-to-end project delivery, ensuring adherence to agreed scope, timeline, budget, quality standards, and regulatory objectives

• Guarantee strict compliance with Julius Baer’s project governance framework, including milestone approvals, stage-gate reviews, and minimum security and control standards

• Manage all administrative aspects of the project lifecycle, including progress reporting, financial tracking, forecast updates, resource planning, and risk & issue logging

• Serve as the primary point of contact for stakeholders across IT, Finance, Treasury, Risk & Compliance, delivering clear and timely communication tailored to audience needs

• Prepare and deliver high-quality presentations to steering committees, executive sponsors, and operational teams

• Champion smooth transition and sustainable handover of delivered solutions to Operations organisations, supported by adequate documentation and change enablement activities

• Apply agile principles and tools effectively, particularly leveraging Jira and Confluence for backlog, task, and knowledge management

YOUR PROFILE

• Proven track record in managing large-scale IT projects with CtB-budgets >CHF 1m

• Familiarity with liquidity risk management frameworks, regulatory reporting, or treasury operations in a financial institution

• Demonstrated experience leading global, matrixed projects involving internal and external teams, as well as third-party vendors

• Hands-on approach to project execution, with proven ability to independently manage all operational aspects of large-scale IT projects, including regular reporting, budget tracking, financial controlling, resource allocation, and milestone forecasting

• Solid command of modern project management toolsets, especially Jira and Confluence

• Certified Project Manager (e.g., PMP, PRINCE2, PMI-ACP, or equivalent)

• Fast learner with strong analytical thinking, capable of quickly grasping complex business contexts, regulatory drivers, and technical landscapes.

• Problem-solving aptitude, emotional intelligence, empathy, and relationship management skills essential for collaborative success

jobs.title: Operations Specialist for Derivatives Processing 80-100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
At Julius Baer, we celebrate and value the individual qualities you bring, enabling you to be impactful, to be entrepreneurial, to be empowered, and to create value beyond wealth. Let’s shape the future of wealth management together.

In Derivatives Processing, you will focus primarily on Exchange-Traded Derivatives (ETDs).
Your responsibilities will include processing derivative trades and lifecycle events, reconciling transactions and positions with our clearing brokers or exchange, and maintaining the post-trade clearing platform.
Job rotation within the team ensures variety and flexibility in daily operations. In your role, you’ll apply your expertise in trade processing and reconciliation, working closely with the team and management to identify opportunities for process improvement and contribute to ongoing optimisations.
Additionally, when required, you may support colleagues in the processing of Over-the-Counter (OTC) derivatives.

YOUR CHALLENGE

• Execution of settlement processes for exchange-traded derivatives (options and futures)

• Processing and settlement of assignment and exercise events

• Administration of corporate action events across asset classes

• Coordination and booking of position transfers (incoming and outgoing)

• Maintenance of settlement instructions and commission tables

• Daily position and cash reconciliation, ensuring accurate trade, position, and financial reporting

• Handling of trade cancellations, corrections, and related adjustments

• End-of-day processing activities, including batch runs and system checks

• Responding to operational queries and ad-hoc requests from key stakeholders, including Trading Desks, Relationship Managers, and other Operations teams

• Providing business support during testing, rollout, and implementation of new products, system releases, and strategic projects

YOUR PROFILE

• Strong expertise in Exchange-Traded Derivative products is essential; knowledge of over-the-counter derivatives is a plus

• Solid risk management skills, with the ability to monitor risk positions and implement mitigation strategies

• Foundational understanding of regulatory requirements, such as FinfraG and EMIR

• Strong affinity for process analysis and continuous improvement

• A collaborative team player with excellent communication and interpersonal skills

• Banking apprenticeship or similar education in the finance industry

• Proficiency in Microsoft Office tools (Excel, Word, Outlook)

• Fluent in both German and English (each at C1 level)

• System know-how in derivative tools is an advantage

jobs.description:
At Julius Baer, we celebrate and value the individual qualities you bring, enabling you to be impactful, to be entrepreneurial, to be empowered, and to create value beyond wealth. Let’s shape the future of wealth management together.

• Data Requirements and Modeling

• Data Management and Transformation

• Produce high-quality, well-tested, and secure code

• Develop and maintain software designed to improve data governance and security

jobs.title: Front Arena Product Owner, Zürich, 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
At Julius Baer, we celebrate and value the individual qualities you bring, enabling you to be impactful, to be entrepreneurial, to be empowered, and to create value beyond wealth. Let’s shape the future of wealth management together.

We’re seeking a highly experienced and driven Product Owner to lead the evolution of our mission-critical Front Arena platforms across global equities and equity derivatives trading. In this pivotal role within Global Markets, you’ll sit at the intersection of technology, trading, and risk, shaping the strategic direction and delivery of best-in-class trading, analytics, and risk management solutions.

With deep roots in financial markets and a proven ability to bridge complex stakeholder needs, you'll drive the end-to-end product lifecycle, from defining the roadmap to overseeing agile delivery and ensuring rigorous quality assurance. You’ll collaborate closely with traders, quants, risk managers, and tech teams across Zurich, Singapore and Mumbai, translating front-office demands into powerful, scalable solutions that power our market-making and trading activities.

We're looking for a strong team player who combines a decade-long expertise in Front Arena, hands-on experience in equity derivatives trading environments, and exceptional stakeholder management skills, someone who speaks both ‘trader’ and ‘developer’ and can navigate high-pressure conversations with confidence and precision.

This is more than a product role; it’s a chance to shape how one of the leading wealth managers trades and manages risk in fast-moving global markets. If you thrive in dynamic, collaborative settings and want to leave a tangible impact on our trading infrastructure, we want to hear from you.

YOUR CHALLENGE

• Roadmap Definition: Defining and executing the strategic roadmap for Front Arena analytics, trading, and risk management tools

• Stakeholder Management: Engaging with traders, platform managers, quants, risk managers, operations managers and various other stakeholders to translate business requirements into functional specs

• Product Development: Overseeing the end-to-end implementation of new features for several equity derivatives trading desks

• Project management and business analyst: Support in the redesign/implementation of market making, trade position management, life cycle management, risk management and trade booking systems

• Quality Assurance: Serving as the last line of defence in user acceptance testing (UAT) to ensure tools are fit for purpose, performant, and compliant with regulatory requirements

YOUR PROFILE

• 10-15 years of Front Arena experience overall and in depth understanding of key technologies used

• Ideally 5+ years Front Arena development experience or equivalent development experience

• Experience working in agile frameworks (e.g., SAFe, Scrum) and DevOps practices

• Extensive experience of working with trading floor stakeholders, 3-5 years of front, risk, or mid office experience ideally

• Extensive experience and knowledge of equity and equity derivatives products in European and Asian structured products

• Proven track record in delivering Front-office trading or analytics tools

We are looking forward to receiving your full job application through our online application tool. Further interesting job opportunities can be found on our Career site.

jobs.title: Legal Structured Products Documentation Specialist (80-100%)
jobs.description:
At Julius Baer, we celebrate and value the individual qualities you bring, enabling you to be impactful, to be entrepreneurial, to be empowered, and to create value beyond wealth. Let’s shape the future of wealth management together.

This is a challenging and interesting role within Legal Financial Products & Institutionals. We are seeking a motivated and committed individual as a legal structured products documentation specialist. As a central point of contact, you will work closely with internal units such as Trading, Sales, Middle Office and Tax, as well as external partners like SIX Swiss Exchange.

Within our well-equipped team you will document all issuances of structured and other securitized products (warrants, leveraged products, AMCs) with the various base prospectuses and specific deal documentation (final terms, termsheet, KIDs in five languages) and also tailor-made (and not yet automated) products and support the life-cycle of such products.

YOUR CHALLENGE

• Prepare and maintain all required documentation for structured products, including issuance prospectuses, term sheets, and Key Information Documents (KIDs)

• Manage the issuance process and oversee listing on the SIX Swiss Exchange through Internet Based Terms (IBT)

• Execute lifecycle events, including processing corporate actions

• Coordinate closely with exchange representatives and other external stakeholders

• Provide general legal and regulatory support relating to structured products

YOUR PROFILE

• Commercial training, ideally in the field of banking, law and/or economics

• A minimum of 2 years of professional experience at a corporate law firm or a financial service provider (preferably banking), ideally in connection with structured products

• Knowledge of the Swiss banking and contract law, in particular financial markets regulation governing the banking industry (FMIA, FinSA) as well as an interest in European financial markets regulations (MiFID II/MiFIR and EMIR)

• Dynamic, flexible and capable of working independently as well as in groups

• Analytical, structured and solution orientated

• Good communicator, capable of coping with pressure and with a natural capacity for persuading and convincing

• Excellent command of English and German is a must, additional languages would be an asset

We are looking forward to receiving your full job application through our online application tool. Further interesting job opportunities can be found on our Career site.
