System engineering is an interdisciplinary field of system and platform engineering, complemented with business management and operational responsibility, that centres around on how to design and manage complex systems and technology platforms over their life cycles. The system engineer can assume a pure holistic role or can be a database, system/server, virtualization or a network specialist.

YOUR CHALLENGE

• Ensuring the operation of core banking applications in respect to application management (2nd level support)

• Processing of incident tickets generated by monitoring systems and the local service desk within SLAs

• Performing coordination / communication tasks between incident managers, applications service owners, 3rd-level support and other IT / Business stakeholders

• Takeover of periodical on-call duty (weekly 7x24)

• Administration of change requests, for application related process fulfillment

• Participation in periodic releases on weekends

• Engage in projects relating to operational aspects for existing or newly integrated applications

• Routine data cleansing of the systems

• Process optimization and automation of repetitive tasks including handover to L1 (Control Center)

• Keep application operation documentation (knowledge database) up to date

YOUR PROFILE

• Completed IT Education (Degree in Computer Science or other IT related field)

• Experience with Temenos T24: Proven ability to manage, monitor, and troubleshoot daily operations, including end-of-day (COB) processing. Proficient in operational tools such as JBoss, Oracle database, TAFJ, DSF, Octopus, Splunk, and Dynatrace. Familiarity with the TPH module is an advantage

• At least 5 years of professional experience in T24 support

• Good Linux know-how (shell scripting is an advantage)

• Knowledge of Java application server and AWA scheduler is an advantage

• Knowledge of ITIL Foundation

• Proven experience in banking with a strong knowledge of financial products

• Process-oriented and analytical approach

• Enthusiastic team player with strong communication skills

• Highly motivated, and proactive, with an eagerness to learn and take on new concepts

• Good written and spoken English, German is a plus

We are looking forward to receiving your full job application through our online application tool. Further interesting job opportunities can be found on our Career site.

jobs.title: Compliance Officer - Governance & Policies 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
At Julius Baer, we celebrate and value the individual qualities you bring, enabling you to be impactful, to be entrepreneurial, to be empowered, and to create value beyond wealth. Let’s shape the future of wealth management together.

For our team within the Central Compliance Department based in Zurich, we are seeking a motivated and detailed-oriented team member to support with the design and implementation of new methodologies and frameworks, as well as support related cross-functional projects across the Bank. The successful candidate will combine compliance knowhow with practical process design abilities and project/initiative experience to drive efficiency, informed decision-making, and ensure disciplined delivery of the Central Compliance key roadmap objectives.

YOUR CHALLENGE

• Support Risk Type Owners in Compliance with the implementation of regulatory developments and industry best practices into internal policies, standards and controls

• Lead and / or participate in key initiatives to set up new methodologies & standards aiming at effective maintenance of the Compliance Risk Management Framework. This includes global harmonisation of methodologies, processes, controls and reporting activities, coordination of resolution of regulatory, external and / or internal audits, etc

• Assist in planning, coordinating and monitoring key roadmap initiatives, budget tracking, ensuring alignment with business and compliance goals, timelines, and regulatory requirements

• Create professional, audience-tailored presentation materials (e.g., PowerPoint decks) to effectively convey insights, project statuses, and business implications to various levels of management

• Collaborate with stakeholders across departments to track progress, identify dependencies, and escalate issues proactively

• Opportunity to interact with senior stakeholders within Compliance and Business and as well as with the Group’s international locations

• Collaborate with partners across all three Lines of Defence and domestic and foreign Group affiliates

YOUR PROFILE

• University degree or equivalent (preferably in banking & finance, business administration, law and / or data science)

• Minimum 5 years of banking industry experience with focus on conceptional work. Exposure to compliance, risk management, legal or audit function in Private Banking is a plus

• Strong analytical, conceptual and problem-solving skills and attention to details, team-player, proactive attitude in approaching tasks owning end-to-end execution

• Proficiency in Excel, PowerPoint and excellent knowledge in additional Office applications (e.g, Share Point). Knowhow in Confluence, Jira or similar tools is a plus

• Stress-resistant, ability to cope with tight deadlines and deliver independently under time pressure

• Good communication skills, ability to build and maintain sound relationship with stakeholders

• Fluent in written and spoken English, other languages are an advantage

We are looking forward to receiving your full job application through our online application tool. Further interesting job opportunities can be found on our Career site.

jobs.title: Assistant Relationship Manager Private Banking - Germany & Austria
jobs.description:
At Julius Baer, we celebrate and value the individual qualities you bring, enabling you to be impactful, to be entrepreneurial, to be empowered, and to create value beyond wealth. Let’s shape the future of wealth management together.

The Assistant Relationship Manager (ARM) Private Banking supports one or more Relationship Manager(s) (RM)/ Team Head(s) (TH) in daily operations, administration, client care and relationship management. The ARM interacts with internal as well as external stakeholders, provides clients with relevant information and supports the RM in implementing customized solutions. Furthermore, the ARM acts as role model in bringing the best service quality to the RMs/TH in a fast, professional and friendly manner, always living the Julius Baer values (Care, Passion and Excellence) and thus helping the team to manage and grow its current client base. He/she channels client feedback to the relevant individuals/departments within the Bank to foster continuous improvement and fast adaptation of processes. This position is the backbone of Client Relationship Management.

YOUR CHALLENGE
Client Administration & Management

• Supports RMs/TH in client interaction and all related tasks (systems, processes, files, documents etc.) with high-quality, precision and timely responsiveness

• Customizes client requests (reporting, statistics, mailings etc.)

• Manages the RM/TH’s calendar, prepares client meetings, organizes business trips, completes the post processing of client calls, client meetings or business trips for RMs/TH

• Compiles presentations, supports in drafting investment  proposals and in marketing activities if needed (client reception, meetings, business trips, events etc.)

• Ensures coverage in case of own absences

Business Management

• Regularly collects and exchanges relevant information necessary for the job

• Organises himself/herself in an efficient and compliant manner and ensures timely and appropriate information of the superior

• Conducts reviews, plans ahead and documents his/her work at all times

• Supports RM/TH in implementation of projects and initiatives

• Provides professional input proposals for improvements based on experience, incident occurrence or observation

• Manages the expense claim process for RMs/TH

Risk Management & Controls

• Actively helps managing risk (support first line of defence), i.e. in client documentation, by raising concerns, following up on issues and by escalating when in doubt

• Ensures adherence to local regulations and compliance with internal policies and standards (e.g. new account openings, payment instructions, reviewing client phone calls or signing off at own level of competence etc.) in collaboration with the respective RMs and TH

• Ensures timely clearance of pending items and escalated deficiencies

• Ensures appropriate ethical and compliant behaviour in his/her area of responsibility

• Ensures correct, meaningful and understandable documentation of client interaction/client orders in the corresponding tool (e.g. CRM, DiAS)

YOUR PROFILE
Personal & Social Skills

• Team player

• Excellent situational adaptability (able to work with RMs and clients from diverse backgrounds)

• Friendly, trustworthy and discreet personality with high level of risk awareness

• Highly service oriented and passionate about client servicing

• Always communicates in a friendly, competent and professional manner

• Open, approachable an displays genuine interest in people and in improving processes

• Systematic, precise and diligent working style and the ability to perform under pressure

• Personal integrity and ethical behaviour

Professional Skills

• Sound affinity with the geographic market(s) covered, i.e. familiar with the legal and regulatory environment as well as cultural awareness

• Good understanding of relevant products and services in Private Banking

• Basic knowledge of global financial markets and current developments in the industry

Education and Experience

• Relevant educational (bank apprenticeship or equivalent) and professional background (work experience in the financial industry)

• Good language skills (verbal and written) according to specific market requirements

• Proven track record in servicing banking clients with complex needs (onboarding of new, maintaining and extending current relationships)

We are looking forward to receiving your full job application through our online application tool. Further interesting job opportunities can be found on our Career site.

At Julius Baer, we celebrate and value the individual qualities you bring, enabling you to be impactful, to be entrepreneurial, to be empowered, and to create value beyond wealth. Let’s shape the future of wealth management together.

Responsible for leading and coordinating a team of IT professionals, overseeing projects and operational day-by-day tasks. Ensures systems efficiency, resource allocation and promote collaboration within the team. Offer technical expertise and act as a role model by delivering value for clients, developing teams and talent, and working collaboratively across the Bank.

• Effectively manage team capacity, including recruitment, coaching, handling performance

• Strong organisational skills, with the ability to strategically plan and allocate resources

• Proven communication skills to deal with employees and stakeholders on different management levels

jobs.title: Platform Engineer – .NET Runtime Platform and Cloud Development Environment 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
At Julius Baer, we celebrate and value the individual qualities you bring, enabling you to be impactful, to be entrepreneurial, to be empowered, and to create value beyond wealth. Let’s shape the future of wealth management together.

We are transforming the way engineers build, deploy, and run software at Julius Baer and we need a forward-thinking Platform Engineer to help drive that change. Join us to shape the future of how our developers work and innovate. We build a robust, automated, and developer-friendly platform ecosystem that empowers product teams to move faster, stay secure, and focus on delivering business value.

As a Platform Engineer, you'll be at the heart of this evolution, designing, developing, and operating scalable self-service platforms that power hundreds of applications across hybrid and cloud-native environments and which are used by our entire developer community.

YOUR CHALLENGE
Responsibilities:

• Design, implement, and maintain modern platform solutions that empower developers with fast, frictionless, and self-service access to runtime environments

• Collaborate closely with software engineering teams to co-design platform capabilities and provide them with a modern, customizable developer workplace with exceptional developer experience

• Develop intelligent automations to streamline platform operations, deployments, and maintenance tasks

• Ensure high availability, performance, scalability, and security of owned services, applying high-quality principles and proactive resilience engineering

• Provide support to key stakeholders, addressing complex technical challenges with a consultative approach and ensuring minimal disruption to business-critical services

• Drive continuous improvement by proactively identifying technical debt, performance bottlenecks, and scalability risks, and lead initiatives to elevate platform maturity, reliability, and developer experience

YOUR PROFILE
Competencies:

• Proven experience as a Platform Engineer, DevOps Engineer, or Systems Engineer

• Understanding of cloud computing concepts, containerization, and orchestration with technologies like Kubernetes, Azure, and Ansible

• Familiarity with Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) tools such as Terraform and their integration into workflows

• Proficiency in scripting languages such as PowerShell, Bash, or Python

• Knowledge of .NET and Windows ecosystem with an exposure to IIS setup and administration

• Highly self-motivated and proactive team player with a strong sense of ownership, customer-centric mindset, a hands-on mentality, and the ability to drive and manage change independently

• Proven track record in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field

jobs.title: Senior Consultant in Real Estate Investment Brokerage 70-100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
Bei Julius Bär Real Estate stehen Ihre Individualität und Ihre Fähigkeiten im Mittelpunkt –damit Sie Einfluss nehmen, unternehmerisch handeln und damit Mehrwert schaffen können, der über das Finanzielle hinausgeht.

At our subsidiary Julius Baer Real Estate, we value the individual qualities that you bring to the table and which enable you to make a difference, be entrepreneurial and take on responsibility. For the development and expansion in Switzerland, Julius Baer Real Estate is looking for a Senior Consultant in Real Estate Investment Brokerage.

IHRE AUFGABEN

• Acquisition, sale, and search of investment properties with a strong focus on investment properties across Switzerland

• Provide support to the Geneva-based team in executing transaction processes from the Zurich office

• Creation of pitches, contracts, and sales documentations

• Project management across entire real estate project cycle

• Market, location analysis of properties and property portfolios

• Advice and consult on project developments for real estate

• Development of marketing strategies and concepts in collaboration with our marketing department and Julius Baer

• Expansion and maintenance of client relationships as well as participation in trade fairs and client events

• Cross-selling to other departments within JBRE as well as Julius Baer

IHR PROFIL

• Above-average bachelor’s or master’s degree in the fields of economics, finance, architecture, engineering or similar

• 2-4 years of professional experience in the fields of real estate brokerage and transaction management

• Effective networker and bring along a broad preexisting professional network in the real estate industry

• Structured, have an eye for details and can think in a networked way

• Excellent team player, highly committed, and flexible

• Fluent in German and have a very good command of French and English

Responsible for all Mortgage risk aspects of a portfolio of domestic and international private banking clients. • Support Mortgage Advisors in all credit related matters and establish regular and proactive contact, providing advisory credit training to Private Banking front office

• Work with legal and external counsel to draft non-standard documents related to credit transactions

• Bachelor's degree or completed studies at a university of applied sciences (economics, banking, finance, law), or equivalent education or professional experience

• Several years of professional experience in the mortgage sector with focus on IPRE, additional Commercial Real Estate knowledge is and advantage

• Profound knowledge on legal aspect regarding mortgage documents and borrowing structures

jobs.title: Identity and Access Management (IAM) Specialist 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
At Julius Baer, we celebrate and value the individual qualities you bring, enabling you to be impactful, to be entrepreneurial, to be empowered, and to create value beyond wealth. Let’s shape the future of wealth management together.

At Julius Baer, we value the unique strengths and perspectives you bring, empowering you to have real impact, to think entrepreneurially, and to shape the future of our organization. As we continue to strengthen our global Identity & Access Management (IAM) capabilities, we are transforming our operating model to establish a clear and effective separation between the first and second line of defence.

Based in Zurich and operating within the Group CISO & Technology Risk Control function of the CRO division, we are looking for a talented IAM professional with a strong understanding of business operations, risk management and regulatory expectations in the banking sector. In this evolving role, you will help shape the future of IAM at Julius Baer by providing independent oversight, challenge and strategic guidance, ensuring that our IAM model remains robust, scalable and compliant across our international footprint.

YOUR CHALLENGE

• Support the transition of IAM into a mature 2LoD governance function by helping define challenge mechanisms, monitoring frameworks and escalation practices. Contribute to continuous improvement of IAM oversight and control effectiveness

• Develop and refine the IAM governance framework and support the evolution of the enterprise-wide IAM Operating Model as responsibilities shift to the 1st line

• Provide independent challenge to ensure policies, standards and the operating model remain risk‑aligned, effective and suited to the Bank’s international context

• Evaluate the effectiveness of 1LoD IAM execution and identify required organizational, process and IT adjustments

• Ensure alignment with IAM policy, architecture

• Provide oversight of the Business Role Catalogue, Business Contexts and Business‑to‑IT mappings

• Challenge modelling decisions made by 1LoD to ensure consistency, least‑privilege design, and adherence to governance and regulatory expectations

• Offer governance and compliance guidance for new business entities, organizational changes and strategic initiatives. Ensure IAM requirements and policies are appropriately integrated into 1LoD planning and implementation

• Oversee the effectiveness of Business Role instance assignment processes and challenge unusual or risk‑relevant access situations. Monitor key IAM control indicators, supervise 1LoD remediation activities and strengthen quality gate criteria without taking on execution responsibilities

• Conduct IAM risk assessments, compliance monitoring and governance reviews. Validate policy exceptions and oversee SoD management. Provide oversight of IAM‑relevant recertification campaigns and support audits with accurate evidence and insights

YOUR PROFILE

• Strong analytical and data‑driven capabilities with the ability to interpret complex IAM and access‑related data, detect anomalies, and translate insights into governance actions. Experience with analytics or visualization tools is a strong asset.

• Deep understanding of banking business operations, including organizational structures, core processes, client‑facing activities, and how these translate into access requirements. Ability to connect business models with IAM governance needs is essential.

• Solid expertise in IAM governance and access control concepts such as ABAC, segregation of duties, business roles, and identity lifecycle risks, ideally within the financial industry.

• Experience in risk management, compliance, information security or IT controls, with the ability to apply a clear 2nd line of defence mindset and independently challenge 1LoD decisions and controls.

• Strong knowledge of regulatory expectations related to identity and access governance, operational risk and IT controls in banking.

• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, enabling effective collaboration and influence across business, IT and control functions in an international environment.

• Ability to thrive in a transforming environment, contributing to the build‑up of a maturing IAM governance function and helping shape new oversight practices, control mechanisms and challenge routines.

• Proactive, structured and self‑driven working style, with the ability to manage complex topics end‑to‑end while maintaining strong alignment with stakeholders.

• Relevant academic background in Information Security, Computer Science, Risk Management, Business Administration or a related field. Relevant certifications are an advantage.

We are looking forward to receiving your full job application through our online application tool. Further interesting job opportunities can be found on our Career site.

jobs.title: Data Platform Responsible 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
At Julius Baer, we celebrate and value the individual qualities you bring, enabling you to be impactful, to be entrepreneurial, to be empowered, and to create value beyond wealth. Let’s shape the future of wealth management together.

As a Data Platform Responsible (PR) you are responsible for the end-to-end technical leadership and lifecycle management of a global data platform (datalake house) ensuring alignment with business needs, architecture standards, and operational resilience. Working closely with Product Owners, Platform Owner, System Architects, and IT Service Owners, the Platform Responsible supports technical decision-making, oversees solution design and drives technical decision-making, responsible for successful development execution, and ensures production readiness and release planning within defined frameworks. The role combines hands-on technical oversight with supplier management, risk assessment, quality assurance, and deep involvement in agile delivery and incident support.

YOUR CHALLENGE

• You are key technical stakeholder in the technical design of a Global Platform based on a modern infrastructure

• You are part of the agile setup and support development team

• Lead the technical design, development, and operational performance of the platform, ensuring full lifecycle management and compliance with corporate standards

• Contribute to platforms technical roadmap, including technology changes, modernisation, and decommissioning, in alignment with business and architectural strategies

• Own and contribute to key deliverables including Solution Design, Security Concept, and Interface Agreements; ensure adherence to architecture standards in collaboration with the System Architect

• Plan and coordinate application releases in line with Change- and Release Management processes, jointly deciding on production go-live with the Product Owner, Platform Owner and ITSO

• Supervise platform infrastructure and data development activities, promote “shift-left” practices (automation, unit testing, CI/CD), and ensure robust implementation of functional and non-functional requirements

• Provide 3rd level support, serve as master data custodian in JBAR, and lead supplier management for third-party applications, including performance and delivery oversight

• Estimate effort for changes, advise on technical risks and mitigation, support budgeting, and ensure technical requirements are properly validated and tested prior to release

• You feel responsible for the global data platform which serves global data for different analytics use cases and ensure a running and stable environment

• Support the System Architect in the raising and maintenance of technical debts

• Support Business Responsible and IT Product Owner in shaping platform service and its execution

• Collaboration with support teams in Asia to ensure enhanced support hours

YOUR PROFILE

• At least 8 years of experience in Data Platforms / Data Lakes / Data Lake houses (Kubernetes, Kafka, Distributed Storage like S3/HDFS) – preferably On prem.

• Several years of work experience in a similar capacity in the financial industry

• Experience in leading technical direction of data platforms, keeping up to date with the modern possibilities of tooling, formats, concepts.

• Experience in managing the full platform lifecycle, from concept and design through development, testing, deployment, operation, and eventual retirement, including responsibility for master data, incident support, and release coordination

• VM setup and scaling (pods), K8S scaling, managing Docker with Harbor, pushing Images through CI/CD together with development team

• Higher Education in Computer Science (University, University of Applied Sciences or equivalent diploma)

• Very strong communication and planning / coordination skills

• Willingness to bring in new ideas and initiate changes and sees themselves as proactive, reliable and solution driven

• Good English language skills (written and verbal), German a plus

• Strong team player

• Customer oriented with focus to support an organisation in providing solutions

• Very good understanding of data technology and its operational management

• Very high level on self-motivation to drive initiatives and initiating changes

jobs.title: IT Sector Lead for Global Shared Services 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
At Julius Baer, we celebrate and value the individual qualities you bring, enabling you to be impactful, to be entrepreneurial, to be empowered, and to create value beyond wealth. Let’s shape the future of wealth management together.

We are looking for a dynamic and technically strong Sector Lead to join the IT Application Management CH department in Zurich. In this role, you will be responsible for shaping and extending the platform provisioning and line management of 3 teams that deliver IT services utilizing both self-developed applications (.Net and Java) and global platforms (Business Process Management, Business Rules, Content Management). You will work closely with business and IT stakeholders to provide sustainable solutions and fulfil mandated and strategic goals.

A key mission of this role is to transform today’s technical platforms into global Target Operating Models (TOM) with workforce in different countries or managed services, ensuring future-proof, innovative platform services for our business.

YOUR CHALLENGE

• Actively promote the COO core values Trust, Ambition, Collaboration and Courage and purpose of Julius Baer to ensure appropriate, ethical and compliant behavior and act as a role model

• Contribute to the Technology Strategy of the IT Division in all its building and ensure alignment with the bank’s strategic direction and Governance. This especially with driving the technical transformation roadmap to evolve today’s platforms toward a global TOM, aligning architecture, processes, platform lifecycle and workforce distribution

• Leading 3 teams to proactively steer and continuously improve technical platforms like RPA (Robotics), Business Process Management, Content Management, Business Rules over various banking domains and deliver as well as operate business applications running on these platforms

• Establish and develop technical delivery teams across different locations, building a global engineering culture and cross-site collaboration model for a modern, innovative and efficient platform strategy

• Act as the key technical counterpart to Architecture and a strategic partner to our business stakeholders to ensure coherent design decisions and platform evolution

• Budgeting and cost management of Operations including Vendor and License Management as well as leveraging near-shoring opportunities and drive for cost-efficiency

• Ensure high-quality technical delivery with strong engineering culture and modern development practices to deliver projects and small IT orders

• Oversee effective risk management and resolution of architecture or governance exceptions. Avoiding and tracking of architectural debts, risk mitigation measures, vulnerabilities, PenTest findings and other exceptions

YOUR PROFILE

• Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field

• Demonstrated ability and experience in leading leaders within the IT domain, effective leadership to employees including performance management and people development and fostering leadership talent

• A visionary mind-set to shape and implement strategic initiatives aligned to the organizational goals

• Proven technical leadership in platform engineering, platform modernization or Target Operating Model transformations

• Strongly decisive and result-oriented person with effective and efficient working style also under high pressure

• Deep hands-on understanding of modern platform technologies (with the maturity being e.g. .Net, Java, Automation Platforms, Business Process Management, Content Management), cloud-native principles and engineering best practices

• Ability to translate complex technical concepts into business‑aligned strategies

• Ability to work in an agile manner and adapt to new situation, ability to motivate others and to work across teams and cultures

• Support the individual locations worldwide from a financial accounting perspective

• Ensuring consistent adherence to internal control systems

YOUR PROFILE

• Completed financial or business administration education with further training in accounting (e.g. specialist certificate in finance and accounting, Bachelor/Master in Accounting or Banking & Finance)

• Several years of professional experience in bank accounting, preferably in the areas of lending, banking operations or corporate actions

• Experience with T24 or comparable core banking systems mandatory

• Sound knowledge of banking products, particularly in lending

• Good understanding of IFRS and Swiss Banking GAAP (RVI) is an advantage

• Project experience with SAP and use of SAP is an advantage

• Sound handling of MS Office programmes

• Very good English language skills, both written and spoken. Fluency in German is an advantage

• Strong analytical skills as well as independent and meticulous  work approach

• Team-oriented personality with strong communication skills and resilience

jobs.description:
At Julius Baer, we celebrate and value the individual qualities you bring, enabling you to be impactful, to be entrepreneurial, to be empowered, and to create value beyond wealth. Let’s shape the future of wealth management together.

The Global Products and Solutions division at Julius Baer is seeking a skilled and experienced System Architect to join our team, with a particular emphasis on technology strategy. As a member of the Architecture Centre of Excellence (CoE), you will serve as the overarching Technology Architect for GPS ART and as a System Architect for one of our Agile Tribe Sets, shaping the future functional infrastructure of the GPS division. You will collaborate closely with Product Owners, Scrum Masters, and Agile Squads to drive the delivery of our roadmap, enabling the development of further digital services and offerings for our clients.

This senior architect role offers the opportunity to work closely with business owners, product managers, and IT stakeholders to unlock the full potential of GPS and develop innovative, efficient solutions that can be presented to C-level executives. The position requires a deep understanding of technology and hands-on experience with global technology trends, particularly in the areas of real-time market data distribution, real-time data analytics, and Azure Cloud setup and migration.

YOUR CHALLENGE

• Collaborate with GPS leadership and key stakeholders to define target and transition architectures, ensuring alignment with the overall enterprise architecture vision and objectives

• Develop and define the GPS Technology Strategy based on enterprise strategy, evaluating new technologies, leading the Technology Architecture Board, and defining technology migration roadmaps

• Conduct hands-on technology assessments, execute proof-of-concept projects, and act as a coach for Agile teams during migration

• Own the solution blueprint and define transition roadmaps with concrete inputs for GPS ART to achieve the target application landscape

• Support teams with adherence to Enterprise Architecture Governance, ensuring compliance with architectural standards, policies, and guidelines

• Stay up-to-date with trends and drivers in the financial industry, markets, and technology, proposing innovative and sound solutions to business partners and supporting them on architecture-related topics

• Facilitate digital transformation and the rollout of global solutions, striking a balance between scalability, operability, flexibility, and geographical adoption

YOUR PROFILE

• Passionate about technology with a "can-do" attitude and entrepreneurial spirit, able to thrive in a fast-paced environment of continuous change

• Proven multi-year experience as a System or Software Architect within the financial industry or consulting with a banking focus

• A successful track record of delivering technology projects, including methodological assessments, strategy definitions, and roadmap elaborations

• Strong knowledge and hands-on experience in at least two functional areas: market data distribution, real-time data analytics, or migration/redesign of software from desktop-based to web-based cloud-native

• Multiple years of experience as a web software developer (Java or .NET)

• Familiarity with various integration technologies (e.g., streaming, messaging, web services)

• Curiosity and knowledge of current technologies, technology trends, and financial market developments

• Strong personal drive, organizational skills, analytical mindset, and problem-solving abilities

• Knowledge of enterprise architecture frameworks, methodologies, and tools; certification in business architecture (e.g., TOGAF, BIZBOK) is highly desirable

• Experience working in an Agile environment is a plus

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to present ideas to technical and business stakeholders at the company, domain, and team levels

• Bachelor's degree in Information Technology (Master's degree preferred)

• Business fluency in written and spoken English; spoken German is beneficial

We are looking forward to receiving your full job application through our online application tool. Further interesting job opportunities can be found on our Career site.
Is this not quite what you are looking for? Set up a job alert by creating a candidate account here.
